overview.en: Bones, the hip joint and 22 muscles in five groups, each with origin, insertion, course, action and nerve.
overview.zh: 骨、髋关节和分成五组的 22 块肌肉，每块写明起点、止点、走行、动作和神经。

text.en: The hip bone is formed by three bones that fuse at the acetabulum: the ilium above, the ischium behind and below, and the pubis in front. The femur meets the acetabulum with its head, and its neck carries the head away from the shaft to the greater and lesser trochanters, where most hip muscles attach.
text.zh: 髋骨由三块骨在髋臼处融合而成：上方的髂骨、后下方的坐骨和前方的耻骨。股骨以股骨头与髋臼相接，股骨颈把股骨头带离骨干，连到大转子和小转子，多数髋部肌肉附着在这里。

text.en: 1.2 The hip joint and its ligaments

The hip joint is a synovial ball-and-socket joint between the femoral head and the acetabulum, built more for stability and weight-bearing than for range of motion. It has three degrees of freedom: flexion and extension about a transverse axis in the sagittal plane, abduction and adduction about an anteroposterior axis in the frontal plane, and medial and lateral rotation about a longitudinal axis in the transverse plane. The close-packed position is usually given as full extension with medial rotation and abduction, and the loose-packed (resting) position as about 30 degrees of flexion and abduction with slight lateral rotation. The capsular pattern is usually listed as flexion, abduction and medial rotation being most limited, although the order varies between authors and with the stage of disease. The capsule and its ligaments wind spirally around the femoral neck, so they tighten as the hip extends and slacken in flexion.
text.zh: 髋关节是股骨头与髋臼之间的球窝滑膜关节，结构上偏重稳定和负重，而不是活动范围。它有三个自由度：绕冠状（额状）轴在矢状面上屈伸，绕矢状轴在冠状面上内收外展，绕纵轴在水平面上内旋外旋。闭合位（紧锁位）通常是完全伸展加内旋和外展；松弛位（休息位）通常是屈曲约 30°、外展约 30° 并轻度外旋。关节囊模式通常是屈曲、外展和内旋受限最明显，但不同作者给出的顺序不同，也会随病程阶段变化。关节囊及其韧带螺旋状缠绕股骨颈，所以髋伸展时它们拉紧，屈曲时放松。

rows.en: Acetabular labrum
rows.zh: 髋臼唇

rows.en: The acetabular labrum is a horseshoe-shaped (C-shaped) ring of fibrocartilage attached to the bony rim of the acetabulum. It is open anteroinferiorly at the acetabular notch, where the transverse acetabular ligament bridges the gap. The labrum deepens the socket and enlarges the contact area with the femoral head, which improves joint stability. Labral tears are more common in hips with abnormal shape, such as femoroacetabular impingement or acetabular dysplasia.
rows.zh: 髋臼唇是附着在髋臼骨缘上的马蹄形（C 形）纤维软骨环。它在前下方的髋臼切迹处中断，由髋臼横韧带跨越这一缺口。髋臼唇加深髋臼窝，扩大与股骨头的接触面，从而提高关节稳定性。髋臼形态异常（如股骨髋臼撞击或髋臼发育不良）时，髋臼唇撕裂更常见。

rows.en: Iliofemoral ligament
rows.zh: 髂股韧带

rows.en: The iliofemoral ligament runs from the anterior inferior iliac spine and the acetabular rim to the intertrochanteric line of the femur. It is shaped like an inverted Y and is therefore also called the Y ligament of Bigelow. It is the strongest ligament of the hip and reinforces the anterior capsule. Because its fibres spiral around the neck, it becomes taut in extension and is the main restraint to hip hyperextension, letting a person stand upright with little muscle activity.
rows.zh: 髂股韧带从髂前下棘和髋臼缘延伸到股骨转子间线。它呈倒 Y 形，因此也称 Bigelow Y 形韧带。它是髋关节最强的韧带，加强关节囊前部。由于其纤维螺旋状绕过股骨颈，伸髋时它拉紧，是限制髋关节过伸的主要结构，使人可以用很少的肌肉活动保持直立。

rows.en: Pubofemoral ligament
rows.zh: 耻股韧带

rows.en: The pubofemoral ligament runs from the superior pubic ramus and the obturator crest to the lower part of the intertrochanteric line, blending with the medial part of the iliofemoral ligament. It reinforces the anterior and inferior capsule. It limits excessive abduction and also helps limit extension. Like the other capsular ligaments, it tightens as the hip extends.
rows.zh: 耻股韧带从耻骨上支和闭孔嵴延伸到转子间线下部，并与髂股韧带的内侧部融合。它加强关节囊的前下部。它限制过度外展，也协助限制伸展。与其他关节囊韧带一样，它在伸髋时拉紧。

rows.en: Ischiofemoral ligament
rows.zh: 坐股韧带

rows.en: The ischiofemoral ligament runs from the body of the ischium behind the acetabulum to the greater trochanter of the femur. It reinforces the posterior capsule and is the weakest of the three capsular ligaments. Its fibres spiral superolaterally around the back of the femoral neck, so they wind tight in extension and medial rotation. It helps resist hyperextension and holds the femoral head in the acetabulum.
rows.zh: 坐股韧带从髋臼后方的坐骨体延伸到股骨大转子。它加强关节囊后部，是三条关节囊韧带中最弱的一条。其纤维沿股骨颈后方向外上螺旋走行，因此在伸展和内旋时被拧紧。它协助对抗过伸，并把股骨头保持在髋臼内。

rows.en: Ligament of the head of the femur (ligamentum teres)
rows.zh: 股骨头韧带（圆韧带）

rows.en: The ligament of the head of the femur is a small intracapsular ligament running from the acetabular fossa and transverse acetabular ligament to the fovea of the femoral head. It carries the artery of the ligamentum teres, usually a branch of the obturator artery, sometimes from the medial circumflex femoral artery. In adults this artery supplies only a small, variable part of the femoral head, so it cannot keep the head alive after a displaced neck fracture. The ligament adds little to joint stability and is slack in most positions.
rows.zh: 股骨头韧带是一条细小的关节内韧带，从髋臼窝和髋臼横韧带延伸到股骨头凹。其中走行着股骨头韧带动脉，通常来自闭孔动脉，有时来自旋股内侧动脉。成人中这条动脉只供应股骨头很小且不恒定的一部分，所以股骨颈移位骨折后它不足以维持股骨头的血供。这条韧带对关节稳定的作用很小，在大多数体位下处于松弛状态。

text.en: The 22 muscles of this chapter fall into five groups by position. Learning the group first gives the main action and usually the nerve.
text.zh: 本章 22 块肌肉按位置分成五组。先记住所在的组，就能推出主要动作，通常也能推出神经。

rows.en: Gluteal group
rows.zh: 臀肌群

rows.en: Gluteus maximus, Gluteus medius, Gluteus minimus, Tensor fasciae latae
rows.zh: 臀大肌、臀中肌、臀小肌、阔筋膜张肌

rows.en: Extension, abduction and pelvic stability in stance
rows.zh: 伸髋、外展，站立时稳定骨盆

rows.en: Deep lateral rotators
rows.zh: 深层外旋肌

rows.en: Piriformis, Superior gemellus, Obturator internus, Inferior gemellus, Quadratus femoris, Obturator externus
rows.zh: 梨状肌、上孖肌、闭孔内肌、下孖肌、股方肌、闭孔外肌

rows.en: Lateral rotation; compress the femoral head into the acetabulum
rows.zh: 外旋；把股骨头压向髋臼

rows.en: Anterior group
rows.zh: 前群

rows.en: Psoas major, Iliacus, Sartorius, Rectus femoris
rows.zh: 腰大肌、髂肌、缝匠肌、股直肌

rows.en: Hip flexion
rows.zh: 屈髋

rows.en: Medial (adductor) group
rows.zh: 内侧群（内收肌群）

rows.en: Pectineus, Adductor longus, Adductor brevis, Adductor magnus, Gracilis
rows.zh: 耻骨肌、长收肌、短收肌、大收肌、股薄肌

rows.en: Hip adduction
rows.zh: 髋内收

rows.en: Posterior group (hamstrings)
rows.zh: 后群（腘绳肌）

rows.en: Biceps femoris, Semitendinosus, Semimembranosus
rows.zh: 股二头肌、半腱肌、半膜肌

rows.en: Hip extension and knee flexion
rows.zh: 伸髋、屈膝

overview.en: The lumbar and sacral plexuses and the six nerves that supply the hip, drawn on the anatomy with their course step by step.
overview.zh: 腰丛、骶丛以及支配髋部的六条神经，画在实体解剖上并逐步讲走行。

paragraphs.en: L stands for lumbar and S for sacral. In an innervation label such as L4–S1, the letters and numbers name the spinal nerves that contribute fibres, not vertebrae. There are five lumbar vertebrae and five lumbar nerves; each lumbar nerve leaves below the vertebra of the same number. The sacral nerves leave through the sacral foramina of a single fused bone, the sacrum.
paragraphs.zh: L 是 lumbar（腰部）的缩写，S 是 sacral（骶部）的缩写。神经支配里的 L4–S1 指贡献纤维的脊神经节段，不是椎骨。腰椎有 5 块，腰神经有 5 对，每对腰神经从同序数椎骨下方穿出。骶神经从骶骨（一整块融合的骨）的骶孔穿出。

definitions.zh: 第 1 骶神经：从骶前孔穿出

text.en: The lumbar plexus (L1–L4) lies within psoas major and sends the femoral, obturator and lateral femoral cutaneous nerves to the front and inside of the thigh. The sacral plexus (L4–S4) lies on piriformis and sends the superior gluteal, inferior gluteal and sciatic nerves to the buttock and back of the thigh. The lumbosacral trunk (L4–L5) links the two.
text.zh: 腰丛（L1–L4）位于腰大肌内，发出股神经、闭孔神经和股外侧皮神经，分布到大腿前面和内侧。骶丛（L4–S4）位于梨状肌前面，发出臀上神经、臀下神经和坐骨神经，分布到臀部和大腿后面。腰骶干（L4–L5）把两者连起来。

text.en: 2.2 Nerves of the buttock and back of the thigh
text.zh: 2.2 臀部与大腿后面的神经

paragraphs.en: Anterior rami of L4–S1, posterior divisions.
paragraphs.zh: L4–S1 前支的后股。

paragraphs.en: The superior gluteal nerve arises from the posterior divisions of L4–S1 in the sacral plexus. It leaves the pelvis through the greater sciatic foramen above piriformis, the only nerve to exit there, together with the superior gluteal vessels. It then runs forward between gluteus medius and gluteus minimus. It divides into a superior branch to gluteus medius and an inferior branch that continues to gluteus medius, gluteus minimus and tensor fasciae latae.
paragraphs.zh: 臀上神经由骶丛 L4–S1 后股发出。它与臀上血管一起经坐骨大孔、梨状肌上方出骨盆，是唯一从此处穿出的神经。然后它在臀中肌与臀小肌之间向前走行。它分为上支和下支，上支支配臀中肌，下支继续支配臀中肌、臀小肌和阔筋膜张肌。

items.en: Supplies: It supplies gluteus medius, gluteus minimus and tensor fasciae latae, the main hip abductors and pelvic stabilizers in single-leg stance. It has no cutaneous branch.
items.zh: 支配：它支配臀中肌、臀小肌和阔筋膜张肌，这些肌肉是主要的髋外展肌，在单腿站立时稳定骨盆。它没有皮支。

items.en: Entrapment or injury: It can be injured by hip dislocation or fracture, hip arthroplasty (especially a direct lateral approach splitting gluteus medius more than about 5 cm above the greater trochanter), femoral nailing and badly placed buttock injections. Findings are weak hip abduction and a positive Trendelenburg sign, with the pelvis dropping on the unsupported side during single-leg stance and gait.
items.zh: 卡压或损伤：髋关节脱位或骨折、髋关节置换（尤其是直接外侧入路在大转子上方约 5 cm 以上劈开臀中肌）、股骨髓内钉以及臀部注射位置不当都可损伤臀上神经。表现为髋外展无力和 Trendelenburg 征阳性，单腿站立和行走时骨盆向无支撑侧下沉。

paragraphs.en: Anterior rami of L5–S2, posterior divisions.
paragraphs.zh: L5–S2 前支的后股。

paragraphs.en: The inferior gluteal nerve arises from the posterior divisions of L5–S2 in the sacral plexus, just above the origin of the sciatic nerve. It passes in front of piriformis inside the pelvis. It leaves through the greater sciatic foramen below piriformis, together with the inferior gluteal artery. It then enters the deep surface of gluteus maximus and ends in several muscular branches.
paragraphs.zh: 臀下神经由骶丛 L5–S2 后股发出，起点紧靠坐骨神经起点上方。它在盆腔内经梨状肌前方。随后与臀下动脉一起经坐骨大孔、梨状肌下方出骨盆。然后从深面进入臀大肌，分成数条肌支而终止。

items.en: Supplies: It supplies gluteus maximus only, the main extensor of the hip when rising from sitting or climbing. It has no cutaneous branch, although it sometimes communicates with the posterior femoral cutaneous nerve.
items.zh: 支配：它只支配臀大肌，臀大肌是从坐位起立或登高时的主要伸髋肌。它没有皮支，但有时与股后皮神经相交通。

items.en: Entrapment or injury: It is most often injured during hip replacement, particularly by a posterior approach, and can also be damaged by pelvic masses and trauma. Findings are weak hip extension, difficulty rising from a chair or climbing stairs, wasting of the buttock and a backward trunk lurch in stance (gluteus maximus gait).
items.zh: 卡压或损伤：臀下神经最常在髋关节置换中受损，尤其是后侧入路；盆腔肿块和外伤也可损伤它。表现为伸髋无力、从椅子上起立或上楼梯困难、臀部萎缩，以及站立相躯干向后倾（臀大肌步态）。

paragraphs.en: Anterior rami of L4–S3; the tibial division comes from the anterior divisions and the common fibular division from the posterior divisions.
paragraphs.zh: L4–S3 前支；胫神经部来自前股，腓总神经部来自后股。

paragraphs.en: The sciatic nerve forms on the anterior surface of piriformis as two divisions, tibial and common fibular, bound in one sheath. It usually leaves the pelvis through the greater sciatic foramen below piriformis (about 85% in a pooled meta-analysis); in about 10% the common fibular division pierces piriformis while the tibial division passes below, and rarer variants include the common fibular division passing above piriformis. In the buttock it runs midway between the greater trochanter and the ischial tuberosity, behind the gemelli, obturator internus and quadratus femoris. It descends in the posterior thigh on adductor magnus, deep to the long head of biceps femoris. It usually divides into the tibial and common fibular nerves at the apex of the popliteal fossa, though the level of division varies.
paragraphs.zh: 坐骨神经在梨状肌前面形成，由胫神经部和腓总神经部两部分包在同一神经鞘内组成。它通常经坐骨大孔、梨状肌下方出骨盆（汇总荟萃分析中约 85%）；约 10% 的人腓总神经部穿过梨状肌，胫神经部仍从下方穿出；更少见的变异包括腓总神经部从梨状肌上方穿出。在臀部，它大致走行于大转子与坐骨结节之间的中点，位于上下孖肌、闭孔内肌和股方肌后方。在大腿后面，它沿大收肌表面、股二头肌长头深面下行。通常在腘窝上角分为胫神经和腓总神经，但分叉水平有变异。

items.en: Supplies: In this chapter the tibial division supplies semitendinosus, semimembranosus, the long head of biceps femoris and the ischial (hamstring) part of adductor magnus, and the common fibular division supplies the short head of biceps femoris. It has no cutaneous branch in the thigh; through its terminal branches it supplies most of the skin of the leg and foot except the medial side.
items.zh: 支配：在本章范围内，胫神经部支配半腱肌、半膜肌、股二头肌长头和大收肌坐骨部（腘绳肌部），腓总神经部支配股二头肌短头。它在大腿没有皮支；通过终末分支分布于小腿和足大部分皮肤，内侧除外。

items.en: Entrapment or injury: It can be injured by posterior hip dislocation and acetabular fracture, posterior-approach hip arthroplasty, injections into the lower medial buttock, and compression by piriformis or other structures in the deep gluteal space (piriformis syndrome). Findings include buttock pain radiating down the back of the thigh, weak knee flexion and, when the common fibular division is involved, foot drop, with pain sometimes worse on hip medial rotation.
items.zh: 卡压或损伤：髋关节后脱位和髋臼骨折、后侧入路髋关节置换、臀部内下象限注射，以及梨状肌或臀深间隙内其他结构的压迫（梨状肌综合征）都可损伤坐骨神经。表现包括臀部疼痛沿大腿后面放射、屈膝无力，腓总神经部受累时出现足下垂，髋内旋时疼痛有时加重。

paragraphs.en: Anterior rami of L4–S1, anterior divisions.
paragraphs.zh: L4–S1 前支的前股。

paragraphs.en: The nerve to quadratus femoris arises from the anterior divisions of L4–S1 in the sacral plexus. It leaves the pelvis through the greater sciatic foramen below piriformis, deep (anterior) to the sciatic nerve. It descends on the back of the ischium and hip joint, deep to the gemelli and the tendon of obturator internus, which separate it from the sciatic nerve. It gives a branch to inferior gemellus and ends by entering the deep surface of quadratus femoris.
paragraphs.zh: 股方肌神经由骶丛 L4–S1 前股发出。它经坐骨大孔、梨状肌下方出骨盆，位于坐骨神经深面（前方）。它沿坐骨后面和髋关节后方下行，位于上下孖肌和闭孔内肌腱深面，这些结构把它与坐骨神经分开。它发支到下孖肌，最后从深面进入股方肌。

items.en: Supplies: It supplies quadratus femoris and inferior gemellus, which laterally rotate the hip, and it gives an articular branch to the hip joint. It has no cutaneous branch.
items.zh: 支配：它支配股方肌和下孖肌，这两块肌肉使髋外旋；并发出关节支到髋关节。它没有皮支。

items.en: Entrapment or injury: Isolated injury is rare; it can be damaged in posterior approaches to the hip or by pathology in the deep gluteal space. The resulting weakness of lateral rotation is usually masked by the other rotators, so the main clue may be deep posterior hip pain.
items.zh: 卡压或损伤：单独损伤少见；髋关节后侧入路或臀深间隙病变可损伤它。由此产生的外旋无力通常被其他旋肌代偿，因此主要线索可能只是髋后方深部疼痛。

paragraphs.en: Anterior rami of L5–S2, anterior divisions.
paragraphs.zh: L5–S2 前支的前股。

paragraphs.en: The nerve to obturator internus arises from the anterior divisions of L5–S2 in the sacral plexus. It leaves the pelvis through the greater sciatic foramen below piriformis, usually between the posterior femoral cutaneous nerve and the pudendal nerve. It gives a branch to superior gemellus, then curves around the ischial spine. It re-enters the pelvis through the lesser sciatic foramen and enters the pelvic (medial) surface of obturator internus.
paragraphs.zh: 闭孔内肌神经由骶丛 L5–S2 前股发出。它经坐骨大孔、梨状肌下方出骨盆，通常位于股后皮神经和阴部神经之间。它发支到上孖肌，然后绕过坐骨棘。再经坐骨小孔返回盆腔，从盆面（内侧面）进入闭孔内肌。

items.en: Supplies: It supplies obturator internus and superior gemellus, which laterally rotate the extended hip and abduct the flexed hip. It has no cutaneous branch.
items.zh: 支配：它支配闭孔内肌和上孖肌，这两块肌肉在伸髋位使髋外旋，在屈髋位使髋外展。它没有皮支。

items.en: Entrapment or injury: Isolated injury is rare. Because it hooks around the ischial spine next to the pudendal nerve, it can be involved in deep gluteal or ischial spine compression and in pelvic surgery, giving deep buttock pain with subtle weakness of lateral rotation.
items.zh: 卡压或损伤：单独损伤少见。由于它与阴部神经并行绕过坐骨棘，臀深部或坐骨棘处的压迫以及盆腔手术都可能累及它，表现为臀部深处疼痛和不明显的外旋无力。

text.en: 2.3 Nerves of the front and inside of the thigh
text.zh: 2.3 大腿前面与内侧的神经

paragraphs.en: Anterior rami of L2–L4, posterior divisions.
paragraphs.zh: L2–L4 前支的后股。

paragraphs.en: The femoral nerve forms within psoas major from the posterior divisions of L2–L4. It emerges from the lower lateral border of psoas and runs in the groove between psoas and iliacus, giving branches to iliacus. It passes under the inguinal ligament into the femoral triangle, lying lateral to the femoral artery and outside the femoral sheath. About 4 cm below the ligament it divides into anterior and posterior divisions, and its longest branch, the saphenous nerve, continues through the adductor canal to the medial leg and foot.
paragraphs.zh: 股神经在腰大肌内由 L2–L4 后股组成。它从腰大肌下部外侧缘穿出，在腰大肌与髂肌之间的沟内下行，并发支支配髂肌。它经腹股沟韧带深面进入股三角，位于股动脉外侧、股鞘之外。在腹股沟韧带下方约 4 cm 处分为前股和后股，其最长的分支隐神经经收肌管下行，分布到小腿和足内侧。

items.en: Supplies: In this chapter it supplies iliacus, pectineus, sartorius and rectus femoris, and it also supplies the three vasti. Its anterior cutaneous branches supply the anterior and medial thigh, and the saphenous nerve supplies the medial leg and foot.
items.zh: 支配：在本章范围内，它支配髂肌、耻骨肌、缝匠肌和股直肌，也支配三块股肌。前皮支分布于大腿前面和内侧皮肤，隐神经分布于小腿和足内侧。

items.en: Entrapment or injury: It can be compressed by an iliacus or retroperitoneal haematoma, for example during anticoagulation, or injured beneath the inguinal ligament by abdominal or hip surgery, retractors or prolonged lithotomy positioning. Findings are weak knee extension (and hip flexion if the lesion is proximal), a reduced patellar reflex and sensory loss over the anteromedial thigh and medial leg.
items.zh: 卡压或损伤：髂肌内或腹膜后血肿（如抗凝治疗时）可压迫股神经；腹部或髋部手术、拉钩或长时间截石位可在腹股沟韧带下方损伤它。表现为伸膝无力（病变位置高时还有屈髋无力）、膝反射减弱，以及大腿前内侧和小腿内侧感觉减退。

paragraphs.en: Anterior rami of L2–L4, anterior divisions.
paragraphs.zh: L2–L4 前支的前股。

paragraphs.en: The obturator nerve forms within psoas major from the anterior divisions of L2–L4 and emerges from its medial border at the pelvic brim. It runs behind the common iliac vessels and along the lateral pelvic wall to the obturator foramen. It passes through the obturator canal into the medial thigh and divides into anterior and posterior branches. The anterior branch runs over adductor brevis, and the posterior branch pierces obturator externus and runs between adductor brevis and adductor magnus.
paragraphs.zh: 闭孔神经在腰大肌内由 L2–L4 前股组成，在骨盆上口处从腰大肌内侧缘穿出。它经髂总血管后方，沿盆腔侧壁走向闭孔。它穿过闭膜管进入大腿内侧，分为前支和后支。前支行于短收肌前面，后支穿过闭孔外肌，行于短收肌和大收肌之间。

items.en: Supplies: In this chapter it supplies adductor longus, adductor brevis, gracilis, obturator externus and the adductor part of adductor magnus, and sometimes pectineus. Its cutaneous branch supplies a patch of skin on the middle of the medial thigh.
items.zh: 支配：在本章范围内，它支配长收肌、短收肌、股薄肌、闭孔外肌和大收肌收肌部，有时也支配耻骨肌。其皮支分布于大腿内侧中部的一片皮肤。

items.en: Entrapment or injury: It can be injured in pelvic surgery, pelvic fractures and childbirth, compressed by an obturator hernia in the obturator canal, or entrapped by fascia over the adductors in athletes. Findings are medial thigh pain or numbness, weak hip adduction and an unstable, wide-based gait.
items.zh: 卡压或损伤：盆腔手术、骨盆骨折和分娩可损伤闭孔神经，闭孔疝可在闭膜管内压迫它，运动员的内收肌表面筋膜也可卡压它。表现为大腿内侧疼痛或麻木、髋内收无力，以及步态不稳、步基增宽。

paragraphs.en: Anterior rami of L2–L3, posterior divisions (origin varies).
paragraphs.zh: L2–L3 前支的后股（起源有变异）。

paragraphs.en: The lateral femoral cutaneous nerve emerges from the lateral border of psoas major. It crosses iliacus deep to the fascia iliaca toward the anterior superior iliac spine. It usually enters the thigh by passing under the lateral end of the inguinal ligament about 1 cm medial to the anterior superior iliac spine, although this distance and its relation to sartorius vary. Just below the ligament it divides into anterior and posterior branches to the skin of the thigh.
paragraphs.zh: 股外侧皮神经从腰大肌外侧缘穿出。它在髂筋膜深面越过髂肌，走向髂前上棘。它通常在髂前上棘内侧约 1 cm 处经腹股沟韧带外侧端深面进入大腿，但这一距离及其与缝匠肌的关系有变异。在腹股沟韧带稍下方分为前支和后支，分布于大腿皮肤。

items.en: Supplies: It is purely sensory and supplies no muscles. It supplies the skin of the anterolateral and lateral thigh, from the greater trochanter region down toward the knee.
items.zh: 支配：它是纯感觉神经，不支配任何肌肉。它分布于大腿前外侧和外侧皮肤，从大转子附近向下到膝部。

items.en: Entrapment or injury: It is usually entrapped where it passes under or through the inguinal ligament near the anterior superior iliac spine (meralgia paresthetica), from tight belts or clothing, obesity, pregnancy, diabetes, or surgery such as iliac crest bone grafting and anterior hip approaches. Findings are burning, tingling or numbness over the anterolateral thigh, tenderness medial to the anterior superior iliac spine and symptoms worse in prolonged hip extension, with normal strength and a preserved patellar reflex.
items.zh: 卡压或损伤：它通常在髂前上棘附近经腹股沟韧带深面或穿过韧带处受卡压（感觉异常性股痛），诱因有腰带或衣物过紧、肥胖、妊娠、糖尿病，以及髂嵴取骨、髋前侧入路等手术。表现为大腿前外侧烧灼、刺痛或麻木，髂前上棘内侧压痛，长时间伸髋时症状加重，而肌力正常、膝反射保留。

text.en: 3.2 Line of pull decides the action
Line of pull relative to the joint centre
text.zh: 作用线相对关节中心的位置

text.en: A muscle's action at the hip depends on where its line of pull passes relative to the centre of the femoral head. A line passing in front of the medial-lateral axis flexes the hip and a line passing behind it extends the hip. A line passing lateral to the anteroposterior axis abducts the hip, and a line passing medial to it adducts the hip. A line passing in front of or behind the longitudinal axis of the femur rotates the thigh. Because the hip is a ball-and-socket joint, changing the joint position moves the line of pull relative to these axes, so several hip muscles change or even reverse their actions as the hip moves.
text.zh: 肌肉在髋关节的作用取决于其作用线相对股骨头中心的位置。作用线经内外侧轴前方则屈髋，经其后方则伸髋；经前后轴外侧则外展，经其内侧则内收；经股骨纵轴前方或后方则产生旋转。由于髋关节是球窝关节，关节位置改变会使作用线相对这些轴移动，所以若干髋部肌肉会随髋关节位置改变甚至反转其作用。

text.en: Piriformis: action reversal with hip flexion
text.zh: 梨状肌：屈髋后的作用反转

text.en: With the hip extended, as in standing, piriformis passes behind the longitudinal axis of the femur and laterally rotates the thigh. When the hip is flexed to about 60° or more, its line of pull moves to the other side of the axis, so it becomes a medial rotator; in the flexed position it also abducts the thigh. This is why the classic piriformis stretch combines hip flexion beyond 90° with adduction and external rotation rather than internal rotation.
text.zh: 伸髋位（如站立时）梨状肌经股骨纵轴后方，作用为外旋大腿。当屈髋达约 60° 或更多时，它的作用线移到该轴的另一侧，于是变成内旋肌；屈髋位时它还能外展大腿。这就是经典的梨状肌牵伸要在屈髋超过 90° 的位置上配合内收和外旋，而不是内旋的原因。

text.en: Adductors: flexors from extension, extensors from flexion
text.zh: 内收肌：伸位时屈髋，屈位时伸髋

text.en: The upper, pubic adductors (adductor longus, adductor brevis and the anterior part of adductor magnus) attach in front of the hip's medial-lateral axis when the hip is extended, so they assist flexion, especially from an extended position. When the hip is already well flexed, about 70° in one source, the line of pull of adductor longus passes behind the axis and it can assist extension. The posterior (ischiocondylar) part of adductor magnus acts like a hamstring: in living young adults its moment arm for extension is about three times its moment arm for adduction, so it is mainly a hip extensor. This dual sagittal action lets the adductors help drive the thigh both forward and backward in sprinting.
text.zh: 伸髋位时，上部（耻骨来源）的内收肌（长收肌、短收肌及大收肌前部）位于髋关节内外侧轴前方，因而协助屈髋，尤其是从伸位开始屈髋时。当髋关节已充分屈曲（有资料给出约 70°）时，长收肌的作用线移到轴后方，可协助伸髋。大收肌后部（坐骨髁部）的作用类似腘绳肌：在年轻成人活体研究中，它的伸髋力臂约为内收力臂的三倍，所以它主要是伸髋肌。这种矢状面的双向作用使内收肌在冲刺跑中既能帮助向前摆腿，也能帮助向后蹬腿。

text.en: Gluteus medius: anterior versus posterior fibres
text.zh: 臀中肌：前部与后部纤维

text.en: All parts of gluteus medius abduct the hip in any position. The anterior fibres run backwards and downwards from the front of the ilium and pass in front of the joint, so they flex and medially rotate the thigh. The posterior fibres run forwards and downwards and pass behind the joint, so they extend and laterally rotate the thigh. When the hip is flexed, all parts of gluteus medius become internal rotators.
text.zh: 臀中肌的所有部分在任何体位都能外展髋关节。前部纤维从髂骨前部向后下走行，经关节前方，所以屈曲并内旋大腿；后部纤维向前下走行，经关节后方，所以伸展并外旋大腿。屈髋时，臀中肌的所有部分都变为内旋肌。

text.en: 3.3 Single-leg stance and the abductor lever
text.zh: 3.3 单腿站立与外展肌杠杆

text.en: In single-leg stance the hip acts as a first-class lever with the femoral head as the fulcrum. Body weight above the stance hip acts through the centre of gravity near the midline, well medial to the femoral head, so it creates an adduction moment that would drop the pelvis on the swing side. The stance-side abductors, mainly gluteus medius and gluteus minimus, pull on the greater trochanter much closer to the fulcrum and must create an equal and opposite abduction moment. Because the body-weight lever arm is roughly two to three times longer than the abductor lever arm (one model uses 12.5 cm versus 5 cm, a ratio of 2.5:1), the abductors must pull with a force greater than body weight, about 1.6 to 2.5 times body weight depending on the model.
text.zh: 单腿站立时，髋关节相当于第一类杠杆，股骨头为支点。支撑侧髋关节以上的体重经身体中线附近的重心作用，位于股骨头内侧较远处，形成使摆动侧骨盆下沉的内收力矩。支撑侧的外展肌（主要是臀中肌和臀小肌）在离支点近得多的大转子上牵拉，必须产生大小相等、方向相反的外展力矩。由于体重力臂约为外展肌力臂的 2 至 3 倍（某模型取 12.5 cm 对 5 cm，即 2.5∶1），外展肌的拉力必须大于体重，依模型不同约为体重的 1.6 至 2.5 倍。

text.en: The femoral head must resist both body weight and the abductor pull, so the joint reaction force is far larger than body weight. Most of this compression comes from the muscles rather than from body weight itself. Estimates for static single-leg stance are about 2.4 to 2.6 times body weight, and simple lever models give about 2.4 to 4 times body weight; during gait the hip is loaded to about 4 to 7 times body weight.
text.zh: 股骨头要同时承受体重和外展肌拉力，所以关节反作用力远大于体重，而且这种压力大部分来自肌肉，而不是体重本身。静态单腿站立时的估计值约为体重的 2.4 至 2.6 倍，简单杠杆模型给出约 2.4 至 4 倍；步行时髋关节负荷约为体重的 4 至 7 倍。

text.en: If the abductors are weak or the superior gluteal nerve is injured, they cannot hold the pelvis level, so the pelvis drops on the opposite (swing) side during stance on the affected limb; this is a positive Trendelenburg sign. To compensate, the person leans the trunk toward the affected stance side. The lean moves the centre of gravity closer to the femoral head, shortens the body-weight lever arm and reduces the abductor force needed; this is the compensated Trendelenburg or gluteus medius gait. In the test, a contralateral pelvic drop during single-leg stance is positive, and one gait study defined it as a drop of more than 4° during single stance.
text.zh: 如果外展肌无力或臀上神经受损，它们就无法维持骨盆水平，患侧单腿支撑时对侧（摆动侧）骨盆下沉，这就是 Trendelenburg 征阳性。为了代偿，患者会把躯干向患侧（支撑侧）倾斜。这种侧倾使重心更靠近股骨头，缩短体重力臂，从而降低所需的外展肌力，这就是代偿性 Trendelenburg 步态（臀中肌步态）。检查时，单腿站立出现对侧骨盆下沉即为阳性；一项步态研究将单支撑期下沉超过 4° 定义为阳性。

text.en: A cane held in the hand opposite the painful or weak hip is pushed into the ground at the same time as the affected foot is loaded. The upward reaction force from the cane acts on the opposite side of the pelvis, a long way from the affected femoral head, so it produces a large abduction-like moment with a small force. In one lever model in which the cane bears about one sixth of body weight, abductor force falls from about 1.6 to 0.6 times body weight and the joint reaction force falls from about 2.4 to 1.3 times body weight. The same cane in the hand on the same side as the affected hip only reduces these to about 1.3 and 2.0 times body weight. Carrying a load in the hand on the affected side has the opposite effect and adds to the adduction moment. The person needs enough strength in the wrist, elbow, shoulder girdle and trunk to transfer the cane force to the pelvis.
text.zh: 手杖握在疼痛或无力髋关节的对侧手中，并在患侧足负重的同时压向地面。手杖产生的向上反作用力作用在骨盆对侧，离患侧股骨头很远，所以用很小的力就能产生很大的类外展力矩。在某杠杆模型中，手杖承担约 1/6 体重时，外展肌力由约 1.6 倍体重降到 0.6 倍，关节反作用力由约 2.4 倍体重降到 1.3 倍。同一手杖若握在患侧手中，只能分别降到约 1.3 倍和 2.0 倍体重。患侧手提重物则作用相反，会增加内收力矩。使用者需要腕、肘、肩带和躯干有足够力量，才能把手杖的力传到骨盆。

rows.zh: 力臂比（体重∶外展肌）

rows.en: Abductor force, no cane
rows.zh: 外展肌力（无手杖）

rows.en: Joint reaction force, single-leg stance
rows.zh: 单腿站立关节反作用力

rows: 2.4–2.6 × body weight (up to ~4 × in some models)

rows.en: Joint reaction force, gait
rows.zh: 步行时关节反作用力

rows.zh: 对侧手持手杖（手杖承担约 1/6 体重）

rows: abductor force ~0.6 ×, joint force ~1.3 × body weight

paragraphs.en: A force couple is two forces of equal size that pull in opposite linear directions but turn a segment in the same rotational direction. At the pelvis, muscles above and below the hip often form such couples to tilt the pelvis.
paragraphs.zh: 力偶是两个大小相等、直线方向相反，却使同一节段向同一旋转方向转动的力。在骨盆，髋关节上方与下方的肌肉常组成这样的力偶来使骨盆倾斜。

paragraphs.en: The hip flexors (iliopsoas, rectus femoris and tensor fasciae latae) pull the front of the pelvis down, while the lumbar extensors (erector spinae and quadratus lumborum) pull the back of the pelvis up. Together they tilt the pelvis anteriorly and increase lumbar lordosis. Tight hip flexors and lumbar extensors with weak abdominals and gluteals is the pattern Janda described as lower crossed syndrome, although it remains a theoretical construct.
paragraphs.zh: 屈髋肌（髂腰肌、股直肌、阔筋膜张肌）向下拉骨盆前部，腰部伸肌（竖脊肌、腰方肌）向上拉骨盆后部，两者合作使骨盆前倾并加大腰椎前凸。屈髋肌和腰伸肌紧张、腹肌和臀肌无力，就是 Janda 描述的下交叉综合征模式，但它仍只是理论构想。

paragraphs.en: The hip extensors, particularly gluteus maximus and the hamstrings, pull the back of the pelvis down, while the abdominals pull the front of the pelvis up. Together they tilt the pelvis posteriorly and flatten the lumbar lordosis. This couple is the antagonist of the anterior-tilt couple.
paragraphs.zh: 伸髋肌（尤其是臀大肌和腘绳肌）向下拉骨盆后部，腹肌向上拉骨盆前部，两者合作使骨盆后倾并使腰椎前凸变平。这组力偶与前倾力偶相互拮抗。

heading.en: Frontal-plane pelvic control in single-leg stance
heading.zh: 单腿站立时骨盆冠状面控制

paragraphs.en: In single-leg stance the stance-side gluteus medius, assisted by gluteus minimus and tensor fasciae latae, pulls the pelvis down toward the stance femur, while the opposite quadratus lumborum hitches the swing side of the pelvis up. Together they keep the pelvis level. If quadratus lumborum is weak, the unaffected side can drop even with intact abductors, giving a false-positive Trendelenburg sign.
paragraphs.zh: 单腿站立时，支撑侧臀中肌在臀小肌和阔筋膜张肌协助下把骨盆向支撑侧股骨拉低，对侧腰方肌则把摆动侧骨盆提起，两者合作维持骨盆水平。腰方肌无力时，即使外展肌完好，健侧骨盆也可能下沉，造成 Trendelenburg 征假阳性。

heading.en: Transverse-plane pelvic rotation over the stance femur
heading.zh: 支撑侧股骨上的骨盆水平面旋转

paragraphs.en: With the foot planted, the hip rotators turn the pelvis over the femur. The anterior fibres of gluteus medius rotate the pelvis ipsilaterally (bringing the opposite side forward), while the posterior fibres and the deep lateral rotators rotate it contralaterally. In loading response, gluteus medius and minimus internally rotate the hip in a closed chain, which advances the opposite side of the pelvis.
paragraphs.zh: 足部固定时，髋旋转肌使骨盆绕股骨转动。臀中肌前部纤维使骨盆向同侧旋转（对侧向前），后部纤维和深层外旋肌则使骨盆向对侧旋转。承重反应期，臀中肌和臀小肌在闭链中内旋髋关节，使对侧骨盆向前转。

text.en: Lumbopelvic rhythm, also called hip-spine coordination, is the kinematic relationship between the lumbar spine and the hips during sagittal-plane movement such as bending forward. Like scapulohumeral rhythm at the shoulder, it shares motion between two regions so that the total range is greater than either region could provide alone.
text.zh: 腰骨盆节律（又称髋—脊柱协调）是指在前屈等矢状面活动中腰椎与髋关节之间的运动学关系。它与肩部的肩肱节律类似，把运动分配给两个区域，使总活动度大于任一区域单独所能提供的范围。

heading.en: Early forward bending: lumbar flexion leads
heading.zh: 前屈早期：腰椎屈曲为主

paragraphs.en: The movement begins with lumbosacral flexion. In the first phases of bending, the lumbar spine contributes more motion than the pelvis, with a lumbar-to-pelvic ratio greater than 1.
paragraphs.zh: 动作从腰骶部屈曲开始。前屈的最初阶段，腰椎贡献的活动大于骨盆，腰椎/骨盆比值大于 1。

heading.en: Mid range: anterior pelvic tilt joins in

paragraphs.en: The pelvis then tilts anteriorly on the femoral heads, which is hip flexion. Lumbar and pelvic motion overlap, and the lumbar-to-pelvic ratio falls progressively. The trunk is lowered against gravity by eccentric work of the lumbar extensors and the hip extensors, especially the hamstrings and gluteus maximus.
paragraphs.zh: 随后骨盆在股骨头上前倾，也就是屈髋。腰椎与骨盆的运动相互重叠，腰椎/骨盆比值逐渐下降。躯干在重力作用下由腰伸肌和伸髋肌（尤其是腘绳肌和臀大肌）离心收缩控制下降。

paragraphs.en: In the final stage most of the motion comes from the pelvis and hips, with a lumbar-to-pelvic ratio below 1, about 0.5 in one study of healthy young men. Tight hamstrings limit this pelvic phase; after hamstring stretching, total pelvic motion increased from about 32° to 42° while lumbar motion was unchanged.
paragraphs.zh: 最后阶段的运动大部分来自骨盆和髋关节，腰椎/骨盆比值小于 1，一项健康年轻男性研究中约为 0.5。腘绳肌紧张会限制这一骨盆阶段；该研究中牵伸腘绳肌后，骨盆总活动度由约 32° 增加到 42°，而腰椎活动度不变。

heading.en: Return to upright: hips first, then lumbar spine

paragraphs.en: The return reverses the order. The hip extensors start by tilting the pelvis posteriorly, and lumbar extension follows toward the end of the movement. Starting at the hips places the spinal extensors in a better position to contract concentrically; if the hip extensors are weak or the hip flexors are tight, the spinal extensors can become overloaded.
paragraphs.zh: 回到直立时顺序相反：伸髋肌先使骨盆后倾，接近结束时腰椎才伸展。先由髋部发动，可让脊柱伸肌处于更有利于向心收缩的位置；如果伸髋肌无力或屈髋肌紧张，脊柱伸肌就可能负荷过大。

text.en: People with low back pain tend to show less lumbar contribution to the rhythm than people without back pain, so the relative contributions are worth observing during a forward-bend screen.
text.zh: 腰痛人群在该节律中的腰椎贡献往往低于无腰痛者，因此在前屈筛查时值得观察腰椎与骨盆的相对贡献。

text.en: 3.6 When each muscle works in walking
text.zh: 3.6 步行时各肌肉何时发力

rows.en: Gluteus maximus
rows.zh: 臀大肌

rows.en: Active from terminal swing through loading response. The lower fibres decelerate hip flexion at the end of swing and then hold the hip against the large flexion moment of weight acceptance; the upper fibres help control the opposite pelvis in the frontal plane.
rows.zh: 从摆动末期到承重反应期活跃。下部纤维在摆动末期减速屈髋，随后在承重时对抗很大的屈髋力矩；上部纤维帮助在冠状面控制对侧骨盆。

rows.en: Gluteus medius, Gluteus minimus
rows.zh: 臀中肌、臀小肌

rows.en: Switches on in terminal swing in anticipation of loading and stays active through loading response and midstance, working eccentrically and then isometrically to stop the opposite pelvis from dropping; activity may continue into terminal stance.
rows.zh: 在摆动末期预先激活，并持续到承重反应期和站立中期，先离心后等长收缩，防止对侧骨盆下沉；活动可延续至站立末期。

rows.en: Tensor fasciae latae
rows.zh: 阔筋膜张肌

rows.en: Its posterior part works with the abductors to stabilise the pelvis in loading response, and its anterior part is active in terminal stance to help keep the hip stable.
rows.zh: 其后部在承重反应期与外展肌一起稳定骨盆，前部在站立末期活跃，帮助维持髋关节稳定。

rows.en: Psoas major, Iliacus
rows.zh: 腰大肌、髂肌

rows.en: Works eccentrically in terminal stance to control the rate of hip extension, then concentrically from pre-swing through mid swing to flex the hip and advance the limb; its burst in initial swing is large and fast.
rows.zh: 在站立末期离心收缩以控制伸髋速度，随后从摆动前期到摆动中期向心收缩屈髋、推动下肢向前；摆动初期的爆发大而迅速。

rows.en: Adductor longus
rows.zh: 长收肌

rows.en: Active in pre-swing and initial swing, where it assists hip flexion as the limb is brought forward.
rows.zh: 在摆动前期和摆动初期活跃，协助屈髋，把下肢向前带。

rows.en: Adductor magnus
rows.zh: 大收肌

rows.en: Active with the hamstrings and gluteus maximus at the end of swing and in loading response, contributing to hip extension and internal rotation during weight acceptance.
rows.zh: 在摆动末期和承重反应期与腘绳肌、臀大肌一同活跃，在承重时参与伸髋和内旋。

rows.en: Biceps femoris, Semitendinosus, Semimembranosus
rows.zh: 股二头肌、半腱肌、半膜肌

rows.en: Begin in mid swing and peak in terminal swing, decelerating knee extension and hip flexion eccentrically; they then help control hip flexion at initial contact and in loading response.
rows.zh: 从摆动中期开始，在摆动末期达到高峰，离心减速伸膝和屈髋；随后在初始着地和承重反应期帮助控制屈髋。

rows.en: Rectus femoris
rows.zh: 股直肌

rows.en: Active in pre-swing and initial swing, where it augments hip flexion while limiting excessive knee flexion; as part of the quadriceps it also helps control knee flexion at loading.
rows.zh: 在摆动前期和摆动初期活跃，既加强屈髋，又限制过度屈膝；作为股四头肌的一部分，它在承重时也帮助控制屈膝。

rows.en: Sartorius, Gracilis
rows.zh: 缝匠肌、股薄肌

rows.en: Sartorius and gracilis join iliacus as concentric hip flexors in initial swing and mid swing.
rows.zh: 缝匠肌和股薄肌在摆动初期和摆动中期与髂肌一起向心收缩屈髋。

text.en: The windows are approximate: they were mapped from phase tables onto standard phase percentages, not read from one EMG study.
text.zh: 这些区间是近似值：按步态分期表对应到标准分期百分比，不是取自某一项肌电研究。

text.en: A two-joint muscle cannot shorten fully across both joints at once, or lengthen fully across both at once. Active insufficiency means the muscle is so shortened over both joints that it cannot contract effectively. Passive insufficiency means the muscle is stretched over both joints so that it limits motion at one of them.
text.zh: 双关节肌无法同时在两个关节上完全缩短，也无法同时在两个关节上完全拉长。主动不足是指肌肉在两个关节上都已缩短到无法有效收缩；被动不足是指肌肉在两个关节上被拉长，从而限制其中一个关节的活动。

heading.zh: 股二头肌、半腱肌、半膜肌

items.en: Active insufficiency: With the hip extended, as in a prone leg curl, the hamstrings are already shortened across the hip, so they cannot fully flex the knee; knee flexion feels weak and the muscle may cramp.
items.zh: 主动不足：伸髋位时（如俯卧屈膝），腘绳肌在髋部已缩短，因此无法把膝完全屈曲；屈膝显得无力，肌肉还可能抽筋。

items.en: Passive insufficiency: With the knee fully extended, the hamstrings are stretched across the knee and limit hip flexion, as in a straight-leg raise or touching the toes; bending the knee slackens them and the hip flexes further.
items.zh: 被动不足：伸膝位时，腘绳肌在膝部被拉长，会限制屈髋，如直腿抬高或弯腰摸脚尖；屈膝可使其放松，髋关节就能屈得更多。

items.en: Active insufficiency: With the hip strongly flexed, rectus femoris is shortened across the hip and contributes less to knee extension; for example, a seated knee extension with the trunk very upright or leaning forward reduces its contribution.
items.zh: 主动不足：屈髋明显时，股直肌在髋部已缩短，对伸膝的贡献变小；例如在躯干非常直立或前倾的坐姿下伸膝，股直肌的参与会减少。

items.en: Passive insufficiency: With the hip extended, as in prone lying, rectus femoris is stretched across the hip and limits knee flexion; this is why the heel reaches the buttock more easily with the hip flexed than when lying prone.
items.zh: 被动不足：伸髋位时（如俯卧），股直肌在髋部被拉长，会限制屈膝；这就是屈髋时脚跟比俯卧时更容易碰到臀部的原因。

overview.en: Special tests, common problems, nerve injury findings, acupoints over the anatomy and a palpation sequence.
overview.zh: 特殊检查、常见问题、神经损伤表现、穴位叠加解剖和触诊顺序。

rows.en: Trendelenburg sign
rows.zh: Trendelenburg 征

rows.en: It tests the hip abductors, mainly the gluteus medius and minimus supplied by the superior gluteal nerve, which hold the pelvis level in single-leg stance.
rows.zh: 它检查髋外展肌，主要是由臀上神经支配的臀中肌和臀小肌，这些肌肉在单腿站立时保持骨盆水平。

rows.en: The examiner stands behind the person with hands on the iliac crests while the person stands on the tested leg for up to 30 seconds. The test is then repeated on the other leg.
rows.zh: 检查者站在受试者身后，双手放在髂嵴上，受试者用被测腿单腿站立最多 30 秒。然后换另一侧重复。

rows.en: The test is positive when the pelvis drops on the side opposite the stance leg. This suggests weakness or inhibition of the stance-side hip abductors, for example from superior gluteal nerve injury, hip pathology or pain.
rows.zh: 若站立腿对侧骨盆下沉即为阳性。提示站立侧髋外展肌无力或受抑制，例如臀上神经损伤、髋关节病变或疼痛。

rows.en: FABER (Patrick) test
rows.zh: FABER（Patrick，“4”字）试验

rows.en: It stresses the hip joint in flexion, abduction and external rotation and also loads the sacroiliac joint.
rows.zh: 它在屈曲、外展、外旋位应力髋关节，同时也加载骶髂关节。

rows.en: With the person supine, the tested leg is placed in a figure-4 position with the lateral ankle on the opposite thigh. The examiner stabilises the opposite anterior superior iliac spine and gently presses the bent knee toward the table.
rows.zh: 受试者仰卧，被测腿摆成“4”字，外踝放在对侧大腿上。检查者固定对侧髂前上棘，轻压屈曲的膝向床面。

rows.en: Reproduction of the person's pain or limited range is positive. Groin pain points to the hip joint or iliopsoas, while posterior pain near the sacroiliac joint points to the sacroiliac joint. Reported accuracy: Physiopedia reports a sensitivity of 0.89 for arthroscopically confirmed hip pathology, and Troelsen et al. (2009) found a sensitivity of 41% and specificity of 100% for labral tears against MR arthrography.
rows.zh: 复现患者疼痛或活动受限为阳性。腹股沟痛提示髋关节或髂腰肌问题，骶髂关节附近的后方疼痛提示骶髂关节问题。报告的准确性：Physiopedia 报告其对关节镜证实的髋关节病变敏感度为 0.89；Troelsen 等（2009）以 MR 关节造影为标准，对盂唇撕裂的敏感度为 41%，特异度为 100%。

rows.en: FADIR (anterior impingement) test
rows.zh: FADIR（前撞击）试验

rows.en: It brings the femoral head-neck junction against the anterior acetabular rim and labrum.
rows.zh: 它使股骨头颈交界处顶向前方髋臼缘和盂唇。

rows.en: With the person supine, the examiner flexes the hip to about 90°, then adducts and internally rotates it.
rows.zh: 受试者仰卧，检查者把髋屈曲约 90°，然后内收并内旋。

rows.en: Reproduction of the person's familiar groin pain, with or without a click, is positive. It suggests femoroacetabular impingement or labral pathology, and a negative test helps rule these out because the test is sensitive but not specific. Reported accuracy: A systematic review by Caliesch et al. (2020) reported a sensitivity of 0.96 and a specificity of 0.11 for FAI.
rows.zh: 复现患者熟悉的腹股沟痛（可伴或不伴弹响）为阳性。提示股骨髋臼撞击或盂唇病变；该试验敏感但不特异，阴性结果有助于排除。报告的准确性：Caliesch 等（2020）的系统综述报告其诊断 FAI 的敏感度为 0.96，特异度为 0.11。

rows.en: Thomas test and modified Thomas test
rows.zh: Thomas 试验与改良 Thomas 试验

rows.en: It assesses the length of the hip flexors: the one-joint iliopsoas, the two-joint rectus femoris, and the tensor fasciae latae with the iliotibial band.
rows.zh: 它评估髋屈肌长度：单关节的髂腰肌、双关节的股直肌，以及阔筋膜张肌与髂胫束。

rows.en: In the modified version the person sits at the end of the table, lies back hugging both knees to flatten the low back, holds one knee to the chest and lowers the other leg over the table edge. The examiner watches the thigh, the knee angle and any abduction of the thigh.
rows.zh: 改良法中，受试者坐在床尾，抱双膝躺下使腰部放平，一侧膝保持抱向胸前，另一腿放下垂于床沿。检查者观察大腿、膝角度和大腿有无外展。

rows.en: If the thigh stays above the table, the iliopsoas is short. If the thigh reaches the table but the knee extends below about 80° of flexion, the rectus femoris is short. If the thigh drifts into abduction or the patella deviates laterally, the tensor fasciae latae and iliotibial band are short.
rows.zh: 大腿抬离床面提示髂腰肌短缩。大腿能贴床但膝伸直、屈曲不足约 80°，提示股直肌短缩。大腿外展或髌骨外偏，提示阔筋膜张肌与髂胫束短缩。

rows.en: Ober test
rows.zh: Ober 试验

rows.en: It assesses the length of the tensor fasciae latae and iliotibial band, although adduction may also be limited by the gluteus medius, gluteus minimus and hip capsule.
rows.zh: 它评估阔筋膜张肌与髂胫束的长度，但内收受限也可能来自臀中肌、臀小肌和髋关节囊。

rows.en: The person lies on the untested side with the lower hip and knee flexed. The examiner stabilises the pelvis, flexes the upper knee to 90°, extends and abducts the hip, and then lets the leg lower toward the table without letting the hip flex or rotate; the modified Ober test keeps the knee straight.
rows.zh: 受试者向非测侧侧卧，下方髋、膝屈曲。检查者固定骨盆，将上方膝屈曲 90°，把髋伸展并外展，再让腿向床面下落，期间不让髋屈曲或旋转；改良 Ober 试验保持伸膝。

rows.en: The test is positive when the thigh stays abducted and does not drop to horizontal (about 10° below horizontal in the modified version). This suggests a tight tensor fasciae latae and iliotibial band.
rows.zh: 若大腿保持外展、不能降到水平（改良法不能低于水平约 10°）为阳性。提示阔筋膜张肌和髂胫束紧张。

rows.en: FAIR (piriformis) test
rows.zh: FAIR（梨状肌）试验

rows.en: It stretches the piriformis over the sciatic nerve by placing the hip in flexion, adduction and internal rotation.
rows.zh: 它把髋置于屈曲、内收、内旋位，使梨状肌在坐骨神经上方被牵拉。

rows.en: The person lies on the unaffected side, and the upper hip and knee are flexed to 90°. The examiner adducts the hip and passively internally rotates it by pressing the shin up and outward.
rows.zh: 受试者向健侧侧卧，上方髋、膝屈曲 90°。检查者内收髋，并向上、向外推小腿使髋被动内旋。

rows.en: Pain in the buttock where the sciatic nerve crosses the piriformis is positive. It suggests piriformis syndrome, but lumbar and sacroiliac causes should be excluded first. Reported accuracy: Fishman et al. (2002) reported a sensitivity of 88% and a specificity of 83% against a delayed H-reflex, which is not an ideal reference standard.
rows.zh: 在坐骨神经与梨状肌交叉处的臀部疼痛为阳性。提示梨状肌综合征，但应先排除腰椎和骶髂关节原因。报告的准确性：Fishman 等（2002）以 H 反射延迟为参照，报告敏感度 88%、特异度 83%；但 H 反射不是理想的参照标准。

rows.en: Log roll test
rows.zh: 滚木试验

rows.en: It rotates the femoral head within the acetabulum without loading the surrounding muscles, so it isolates the hip joint and capsule.
rows.zh: 它使股骨头在髋臼内旋转而不加载周围肌肉，因此可单独检查髋关节和关节囊。

rows.en: With the person supine and the leg straight in neutral, the examiner rolls the whole leg passively into full internal and then external rotation.
rows.zh: 受试者仰卧、腿伸直于中立位，检查者将整条腿被动滚向最大内旋，再滚向最大外旋。

rows.en: Pain, a click or pop, or more rotation than on the other side is positive. Clicking may suggest a labral tear, and excess rotation may suggest capsular or ligamentous laxity.
rows.zh: 出现疼痛、咔嗒声或弹响，或旋转范围大于对侧为阳性。弹响可能提示盂唇撕裂，旋转过度可能提示关节囊或韧带松弛。

rows.en: Hip scour (quadrant) test
rows.zh: 髋关节研磨（象限）试验

rows.en: It compresses and grinds the femoral head against the acetabular rim, cartilage and labrum.
rows.zh: 它挤压并研磨股骨头与髋臼缘、软骨和盂唇。

rows.en: With the person supine, the examiner flexes the hip and knee to about 90°, pushes down along the femur, and sweeps the hip through an arc from adduction to abduction.
rows.zh: 受试者仰卧，检查者把髋、膝屈曲约 90°，沿股骨长轴向下加压，并使髋从内收向外展做弧形摆动。

rows.en: Pain, crepitus or reduced range is positive. It suggests intra-articular pathology such as osteoarthritis, a chondral lesion or a labral tear.
rows.zh: 出现疼痛、摩擦感或活动范围减小为阳性。提示关节内病变，如骨关节炎、软骨损伤或盂唇撕裂。

rows.en: Ely test
rows.zh: Ely 试验

rows.en: It assesses the length or spasticity of the rectus femoris, the two-joint hip flexor and knee extensor.
rows.zh: 它评估股直肌（双关节的屈髋伸膝肌）的长度或痉挛。

rows.en: With the person prone, the examiner stabilises the low back and passively flexes the knee, bringing the heel toward the buttock.
rows.zh: 受试者俯卧，检查者固定腰部，被动屈膝，使足跟靠近臀部。

rows.en: The test is positive when the heel cannot reach the buttock or the hip on the tested side lifts off the table. This suggests a short or spastic rectus femoris. Reported accuracy: Physiopedia reports a sensitivity of about 56% to 59% and a specificity of about 64% to 85%, mainly from studies in cerebral palsy.
rows.zh: 足跟碰不到臀部或被测侧髋抬离床面为阳性。提示股直肌短缩或痉挛。报告的准确性：Physiopedia 报告敏感度约 56%–59%，特异度约 64%–85%，主要来自脑瘫人群的研究。

rows.en: 90-90 hamstring length test
rows.zh: 90-90 腘绳肌长度试验

rows.en: It measures hamstring length with the hip fixed at 90° so the nerve is less tensioned than in a straight leg raise.
rows.zh: 它在髋固定于 90° 的位置测量腘绳肌长度，神经受牵拉比直腿抬高少。

rows.en: The person lies supine with the hip and knee both flexed to 90° and holds the back of the thigh. The person then actively straightens the knee as far as possible while the low back stays neutral, and the remaining knee angle is measured.
rows.zh: 受试者仰卧，髋、膝均屈曲 90°，双手抱住大腿后方。然后在腰部保持中立的情况下主动尽量伸膝，测量剩余的膝屈曲角度。

rows.en: A larger loss of knee extension, compared with the other side, indicates shorter hamstrings. Symptoms that stay in the posterior thigh and do not change with ankle or neck movement point to the muscle rather than the nerve.
rows.zh: 与对侧相比，伸膝缺失角度越大提示腘绳肌越短。症状停留在大腿后方、且不随踝或颈部动作改变时，更支持肌肉而不是神经来源。

rows.en: Straight leg raise with structural differentiation
rows.zh: 直腿抬高试验（结构区分）

rows.en: It tensions the sciatic nerve and the L4–S1 nerve roots, but it also stretches the hamstrings, so a sensitising movement is needed to tell them apart.
rows.zh: 它牵拉坐骨神经及 L4–S1 神经根，但同时也牵拉腘绳肌，因此需要加入敏化动作来区分两者。

rows.en: With the person supine, the examiner raises the straight leg by flexing the hip. At the point where symptoms appear, the examiner adds passive ankle dorsiflexion, which tensions the nerve without moving the hamstrings.
rows.zh: 受试者仰卧，检查者保持伸膝抬高下肢。在症状出现的角度，加入被动踝背伸；这会牵拉神经而不改变腘绳肌长度。

rows.en: Leg pain between about 30° and 70° of hip flexion that worsens with ankle dorsiflexion suggests neural tension, such as lumbar disc herniation at L4–S1. Posterior thigh tightness that does not change with dorsiflexion suggests hamstring length limitation instead. Reported accuracy: For lumbar disc herniation, van der Windt et al. reported a pooled sensitivity of 0.92 and a pooled specificity of 0.28.
rows.zh: 髋屈曲约 30°–70° 之间出现下肢痛、且踝背伸使其加重，提示神经张力问题，如 L4–S1 椎间盘突出。大腿后方紧绷感不随背伸改变，则更提示腘绳肌长度受限。报告的准确性：对于腰椎间盘突出，van der Windt 等报告合并敏感度 0.92，合并特异度 0.28。

rows.en: Resisted adduction and adductor squeeze test
rows.zh: 抗阻内收与内收肌挤压试验

rows.en: It loads the adductor group, especially the adductor longus at its pubic origin.
rows.zh: 它加载内收肌群，尤其是耻骨起点处的长收肌。

rows.en: The person lies supine and squeezes the examiner's fist or forearm between the knees, usually with the hips at 45°, and it can be repeated at 0° and 90° of hip flexion. Single-leg adduction against resistance can also be tested.
rows.zh: 受试者仰卧，用双膝夹紧检查者的拳头或前臂，通常髋屈 45°，也可在髋屈 0° 和 90° 重复。还可以做单腿抗阻内收。

rows.en: Reproduction of the person's familiar pain in the adductors, together with adductor tenderness, defines adductor-related groin pain under the Doha classification. Pain felt in the inguinal region instead points to a different entity.
rows.zh: 在内收肌处复现患者熟悉的疼痛，并伴内收肌压痛，按 Doha 分类即为内收肌相关腹股沟痛。若疼痛位于腹股沟管区域，则提示其他类型。

text.en: 4.2 Common problems and the structures involved

heading.zh: 大转子疼痛综合征（臀肌腱病）

items.en: Structures: It mainly involves the gluteus medius and gluteus minimus tendons at the greater trochanter, with the trochanteric bursae secondarily involved.
items.zh: 结构：主要累及大转子处的臀中肌和臀小肌腱，大转子滑囊为继发受累。

items.en: Mechanism: Tendons are compressed against the greater trochanter in hip adduction, such as crossing the legs or lying on the side, and overloaded by sudden increases in activity. It is most common in women over 40.
items.zh: 机制：髋内收时（如跷二郎腿、侧卧）肌腱被压向大转子，活动量骤增时又过度负荷。最常见于 40 岁以上女性。

items.en: Key findings: Pain and tenderness over the greater trochanter are typical, and lying on the affected side disturbs sleep. Single-leg stance and resisted adduction tests often reproduce the lateral hip pain.
items.zh: 主要表现：典型表现为大转子处疼痛和压痛，患侧卧位影响睡眠。单腿站立和抗阻内收等试验常复现髋外侧痛。

heading.en: Femoroacetabular impingement syndrome and labral tear
heading.zh: 股骨髋臼撞击综合征与盂唇撕裂

items.en: Structures: It involves the femoral head-neck junction (cam morphology) or the acetabular rim (pincer morphology), with damage to the labrum and articular cartilage.
items.zh: 结构：累及股骨头颈交界处（凸轮型形态）或髋臼缘（钳夹型形态），并损伤盂唇和关节软骨。

items.en: Mechanism: Abnormal bone shape causes early contact between the femur and acetabulum during flexion and internal rotation, which repeatedly loads the labrum and cartilage.
items.zh: 机制：骨形态异常使屈曲和内旋时股骨与髋臼过早接触，反复加载盂唇和软骨。

items.en: Key findings: Motion- or position-related hip or groin pain is the main symptom, often with clicking, catching or stiffness. Internal rotation in flexion is reduced, and the FADIR test reproduces the familiar pain; diagnosis requires symptoms, signs and imaging together.
items.zh: 主要表现：主要症状是与动作或体位相关的髋部或腹股沟痛，常伴弹响、卡住感或僵硬。屈曲位内旋减少，FADIR 试验复现熟悉的疼痛；诊断需要症状、体征和影像三者同时具备。

items.en: Structures: It most often involves the long head of the biceps femoris, especially near its proximal musculotendinous junction; stretch-type injuries often involve the proximal semimembranosus tendon.
items.zh: 结构：最常累及股二头肌长头，尤其是近端肌肉-肌腱连接处；牵拉型损伤常累及半膜肌近端肌腱。

items.en: Mechanism: Sprint-type strains occur in high-speed running, usually in late swing when the hamstrings contract eccentrically to slow the extending knee. Stretch-type strains occur with extreme hip flexion and knee extension, such as kicking or dancing.
items.zh: 机制：冲刺型拉伤发生在高速跑，通常在摆动末期，腘绳肌离心收缩以减慢伸膝。牵拉型拉伤发生在极度屈髋伸膝时，如踢腿或舞蹈。

items.en: Key findings: Sudden sharp posterior thigh pain, sometimes with a pop, is typical. Palpation finds focal tenderness, and resisted knee flexion and a passive straight leg raise provoke pain; bruising may appear 24 to 72 hours later.
items.zh: 主要表现：典型表现为大腿后方突发锐痛，有时伴“啪”的感觉。触诊有局部压痛，抗阻屈膝和被动直腿抬高诱发疼痛；24–72 小时后可出现瘀斑。

items.en: Structures: It most often involves the adductor longus at its pubic origin or musculotendinous junction.
items.zh: 结构：最常累及长收肌的耻骨起点或肌肉-肌腱连接处。

items.en: Mechanism: It arises from a sudden injury or gradual overuse in multidirectional sports such as football, rugby and hockey.
items.zh: 机制：由突发损伤或逐渐过度使用引起，多见于足球、橄榄球、曲棍球等多方向运动。

items.en: Key findings: Under the Doha classification, it is defined by adductor tenderness plus pain on resisted adduction felt in the adductors. Squeeze tests at 0°, 45° or 90° of hip flexion often reproduce the familiar pain.
items.zh: 主要表现：按 Doha 分类，其定义为内收肌压痛加上抗阻内收时内收肌处疼痛。髋屈 0°、45° 或 90° 的挤压试验常复现熟悉的疼痛。

heading.en: Piriformis syndrome and deep gluteal syndrome
heading.zh: 梨状肌综合征与深臀综合征

items.en: Structures: It involves the sciatic nerve in the deep gluteal space, where it can be compressed by the piriformis, fibrous bands, the gemelli-obturator internus complex or the hamstring origin.
items.zh: 结构：累及深臀部间隙中的坐骨神经，可被梨状肌、纤维束带、孖肌-闭孔内肌复合体或腘绳肌起点压迫。

items.en: Mechanism: Muscle hypertrophy, anatomical variation, fibrous bands or prolonged sitting compress or tether the nerve beneath the gluteus maximus.
items.zh: 机制：肌肉肥大、解剖变异、纤维束带或久坐使神经在臀大肌深面受压或被牵绊。

items.en: Key findings: Deep buttock pain that worsens after about 20 to 30 minutes of sitting is typical, often radiating down the posterior thigh. Tenderness at the sciatic notch and pain on the FAIR or seated piriformis stretch test support the diagnosis.
items.zh: 主要表现：典型表现为久坐约 20–30 分钟后加重的深部臀痛，常向大腿后方放射。坐骨切迹压痛以及 FAIR 或坐位梨状肌牵拉试验诱发疼痛支持诊断。

items.en: Structures: It involves the articular cartilage of the femoral head and acetabulum, the subchondral bone and the joint capsule.
items.zh: 结构：累及股骨头和髋臼的关节软骨、软骨下骨和关节囊。

items.en: Mechanism: Cartilage gradually degenerates with age and joint loading, and the capsule stiffens, so rotation and flexion are lost.
items.zh: 机制：软骨随年龄和关节负荷逐渐退变，关节囊变僵硬，因此旋转和屈曲受限。

items.en: Key findings: Groin or hip pain with internal rotation below 15° and hip flexion of 115° or less meets the ACR clinical criteria. In people over 50, pain on internal rotation with morning stiffness under 60 minutes also fits.
items.zh: 主要表现：腹股沟或髋部疼痛，且内旋小于 15°、屈髋不超过 115°，即符合 ACR 临床标准。50 岁以上者，内旋痛伴晨僵少于 60 分钟也符合。

heading.zh: 髂腰肌肌腱病与弹响髋

items.en: Structures: Internal snapping involves the iliopsoas tendon over the iliopectineal eminence or femoral head, and external snapping involves the iliotibial band or anterior gluteus maximus over the greater trochanter.
items.zh: 结构：内侧弹响累及跨过髂耻隆起或股骨头的髂腰肌腱；外侧弹响累及跨过大转子的髂胫束或臀大肌前缘。

items.en: Mechanism: The tendon catches as the hip moves from flexion, abduction and external rotation into extension and internal rotation; inflammation of the iliopsoas bursa or tendon raises the risk.
items.zh: 机制：髋从屈曲、外展、外旋位转向伸展、内旋位时肌腱被卡住；髂腰肌滑囊或肌腱的炎症增加风险。

items.en: Key findings: Internal snapping produces an audible pop in the groin, and the iliopsoas test reproduces it. External snapping is felt and seen at the lateral hip rather than heard, and pressure over the greater trochanter can stop it.
items.zh: 主要表现：内侧弹响在腹股沟处发出可听见的“啪”声，髂腰肌试验可复现。外侧弹响多可在髋外侧摸到和看到而非听到，按压大转子可使其消失。

text.en: 4.3 Nerve injury: sensory and motor findings
text.zh: 4.3 神经损伤：感觉与运动表现

rows.en: Superior gluteal nerve
rows.zh: 臀上神经

rows.en: The superior gluteal nerve (usually L4–S1) supplies the gluteus medius, gluteus minimus and tensor fasciae latae, so injury weakens hip abduction and internal rotation.
rows.zh: 臀上神经（通常 L4–S1）支配臀中肌、臀小肌和阔筋膜张肌，损伤后髋外展和内旋无力。

rows.en: It has no cutaneous sensory territory, so sensation is normal.
rows.zh: 它没有皮肤感觉支配区，因此感觉正常。

rows.en: The pelvis drops on the swing side during stance on the affected leg, giving a positive Trendelenburg sign; people often lean the trunk over the affected hip, producing a Trendelenburg (waddling) gait.
rows.zh: 患侧支撑时摆动侧骨盆下沉，Trendelenburg 征阳性；患者常把躯干倾向患侧髋，形成 Trendelenburg（鸭步）步态。

rows.en: Common causes are the lateral (Hardinge) approach to the hip, where splitting the gluteus medius more than about 5 cm above the greater trochanter can denervate it, and hip dislocation.
rows.zh: 常见原因是髋关节外侧（Hardinge）入路，在大转子上方超过约 5 cm 处劈开臀中肌可造成去神经；髋关节脱位也可导致损伤。

rows.en: Inferior gluteal nerve
rows.zh: 臀下神经

rows.en: The inferior gluteal nerve (L5–S2) supplies only the gluteus maximus, so injury weakens hip extension.
rows.zh: 臀下神经（L5–S2）只支配臀大肌，损伤后伸髋无力。

rows.en: It has no cutaneous territory of its own, so sensation is usually normal.
rows.zh: 它没有自己的皮肤感觉区，因此感觉通常正常。

rows.en: The trunk lurches backward at heel strike on the affected side to keep the hip extended (gluteus maximus lurch), and climbing stairs or rising from a chair is difficult.
rows.zh: 患侧足跟着地时躯干向后倾以维持伸髋（臀大肌步态），上楼梯和从椅子上站起困难。

rows.en: Common causes are posterior approaches and revision total hip arthroplasty, compression by a pelvic mass, trauma, and deep gluteal injections.
rows.zh: 常见原因包括后入路及翻修全髋关节置换、盆腔肿块压迫、外伤和臀部深层注射。

rows.en: Sciatic nerve
rows.zh: 坐骨神经

rows.en: The sciatic nerve (L4–S3) supplies the hamstrings and the hamstring part of the adductor magnus, and through its tibial and common fibular branches all muscles below the knee, so injury weakens knee flexion and all ankle and foot movement.
rows.zh: 坐骨神经（L4–S3）支配腘绳肌和大收肌的腘绳肌部，并通过胫神经和腓总神经支配膝以下全部肌肉，损伤后屈膝及踝、足全部运动无力。

rows.en: Sensation is lost over most of the leg below the knee and the foot, sparing the medial leg supplied by the saphenous nerve.
rows.zh: 膝以下小腿大部分和足部感觉丧失，但隐神经支配的小腿内侧不受累。

rows.en: Foot drop leads to a steppage gait, in which the hip and knee lift high to clear the toes, and the ankle jerk may be reduced.
rows.zh: 足下垂导致跨阈步态，即抬高髋和膝以使足趾离地；跟腱反射可减弱。

rows.en: Common causes are posterior hip dislocation, pelvic fracture, total hip arthroplasty, poorly placed gluteal intramuscular injections, and compression in the deep gluteal space such as by the piriformis.
rows.zh: 常见原因包括髋关节后脱位、骨盆骨折、全髋关节置换、臀部肌内注射位置不当，以及深臀部间隙（如梨状肌）压迫。

rows.en: Femoral nerve
rows.zh: 股神经

rows.en: The femoral nerve (L2–L4) supplies the iliacus, pectineus, sartorius and quadriceps, so injury weakens knee extension and, if the lesion is above the inguinal ligament, hip flexion.
rows.zh: 股神经（L2–L4）支配髂肌、耻骨肌、缝匠肌和股四头肌，损伤后伸膝无力；若病变在腹股沟韧带以上，屈髋也无力。

rows.en: Sensation is lost over the anterior and medial thigh and, through the saphenous nerve, the medial leg and foot.
rows.zh: 大腿前内侧感觉丧失，并经隐神经影响小腿和足内侧。

rows.en: The knee buckles in stance because the quadriceps cannot lock it, and the patellar reflex is reduced or absent.
rows.zh: 支撑期因股四头肌无法锁住膝关节而出现打软腿，膝反射减弱或消失。

rows.en: Common causes are retractor pressure in abdominal or pelvic surgery, hip arthroplasty, prolonged lithotomy positioning, retroperitoneal or iliopsoas haematoma (often with anticoagulation), and diabetic amyotrophy.
rows.zh: 常见原因包括腹盆腔手术牵开器压迫、髋关节置换、长时间截石位、腹膜后或髂腰肌血肿（常与抗凝有关）以及糖尿病性肌萎缩。

rows.en: Obturator nerve
rows.zh: 闭孔神经

rows.en: The obturator nerve (L2–L4) supplies the adductor longus, brevis, the adductor part of the adductor magnus, gracilis and obturator externus, so injury weakens hip adduction.
rows.zh: 闭孔神经（L2–L4）支配长收肌、短收肌、大收肌的内收肌部、股薄肌和闭孔外肌，损伤后髋内收无力。

rows.en: Numbness, tingling or pain affects the skin of the middle part of the medial thigh.
rows.zh: 大腿内侧中部皮肤麻木、刺痛或疼痛。

rows.en: The leg feels unstable, and a circumducting gait with an externally rotated hip may appear because the adductors cannot control the swinging limb.
rows.zh: 下肢感觉不稳；由于内收肌不能控制摆动腿，可出现髋外旋的划圈步态。

rows.en: Common causes are pelvic and abdominal surgery or positioning during hip replacement, childbirth, pelvic trauma, osteitis pubis and athletic entrapment.
rows.zh: 常见原因包括盆腹腔手术或髋关节置换时的体位、分娩、骨盆外伤、耻骨炎以及运动相关的卡压。

rows.en: Lateral femoral cutaneous nerve
rows.zh: 股外侧皮神经

rows.en: The lateral femoral cutaneous nerve (L2–L3) is purely sensory, so there is no weakness; weakness or reflex change points to another diagnosis.
rows.zh: 股外侧皮神经（L2–L3）是纯感觉神经，因此没有肌力减弱；若出现无力或反射改变，应考虑其他诊断。

rows.en: Burning pain, tingling or numbness affects an oval area of the anterolateral thigh (meralgia paresthetica).
rows.zh: 大腿前外侧一块椭圆形区域出现烧灼痛、刺痛或麻木（感觉异常性股痛）。

rows.en: Gait is normal, although prolonged standing or walking with the hip extended may aggravate the symptoms.
rows.zh: 步态正常，但长时间站立或伸髋行走可能加重症状。

rows.en: Common causes are compression where the nerve passes under the inguinal ligament near the anterior superior iliac spine by tight belts or clothing, obesity or pregnancy, and surgery such as hip replacement or iliac crest bone graft harvesting; diabetes is also a risk factor.
rows.zh: 常见原因是神经在髂前上棘附近穿过腹股沟韧带下方处受压，如紧腰带或紧身衣物、肥胖或妊娠，以及髋关节置换、髂嵴取骨等手术；糖尿病也是危险因素。

text.en: The overlay figure and the acupoint table are a learning reference. The positions are drawn on a schematic body, are not clinically calibrated, and do not indicate needling depth, direction or path. Each point lists its meridian first.
text.zh: 叠加图和穴位表是学习参照。位置画在示意人体上，未经临床校准，不表示进针深度、方向或路径。每个穴位先写所属经脉。

summary.en: Acupoints of the hip and thigh · 9 entries
summary.zh: 髋部与大腿穴位 · 9 个条目

text.en: Place both hands on the waist and slide down onto the iliac crests, then follow each crest forward to the ASIS.
text.zh: 双手放在腰部向下滑到髂嵴，再沿髂嵴向前摸到髂前上棘。

text.en: Follow the crest backwards to the dimples above the buttocks; the PSIS lies just under each dimple, at about the S2 level.
text.zh: 沿髂嵴向后摸到臀部上方的两个小窝，髂后上棘就在小窝下面，约平 S2。

text.en: Below the iliac crest on the side of the thigh, feel the large bony prominence; it rolls under the fingers when the hip rotates internally and externally.
text.zh: 在髂嵴下方大腿外侧摸到大的骨性隆起；内旋、外旋髋时它在手指下滚动。

text.en: With the person lying on the side and the hip flexed, press up into the lower buttock; the tuberosity is the hard point the hamstrings pull from.
text.zh: 侧卧屈髋，在臀下部向上按，摸到的硬点就是坐骨结节，腘绳肌从这里起始。

text.en: With the hip abducted and resisted adduction, the most prominent cord in the groin near the pubis is the adductor longus tendon.
text.zh: 髋外展后做抗阻内收，腹股沟靠近耻骨处最明显的条索就是长收肌腱。

text.en: Below the inguinal ligament, between sartorius and adductor longus, feel the femoral pulse; the femoral nerve lies just lateral to it.
text.zh: 在腹股沟韧带下方、缝匠肌和长收肌之间摸到股动脉搏动，股神经紧贴其外侧。

overview.en: Short memory cues, then questions with full answers, then what the week of daily pushes will add.
overview.zh: 先看简记口诀，再用完整问答自测，最后是本周每日推送要补的内容。

text.en: From top to bottom, the deep lateral rotators are piriformis, superior gemellus, obturator internus, inferior gemellus, obturator externus and quadratus femoris.
text.zh: 深层外旋肌从上到下依次是梨状肌、上孖肌、闭孔内肌、下孖肌、闭孔外肌和股方肌。

text.en: The superior gluteal nerve supplies gluteus medius, gluteus minimus and tensor fasciae latae; the inferior gluteal nerve supplies only gluteus maximus.
text.zh: 臀上神经支配臀中肌、臀小肌和阔筋膜张肌；臀下神经只支配臀大肌。

blocks.original: 上管中小张，下管大一个。

text.en: The pes anserinus is sartorius, gracilis and semitendinosus, supplied by the femoral, obturator and sciatic nerves.
text.zh: 鹅足由缝匠肌、股薄肌、半腱肌组成，分别由股神经、闭孔神经、坐骨神经支配。

text.en: Front muscles flex, back muscles extend, outside muscles abduct, inside muscles adduct.
text.zh: 前面的肌肉屈髋，后面的伸髋，外侧的外展，内侧的内收。

text.zh: 5.3 本周每日推送要补全的内容

text.en: This chapter is the Sunday overview. Monday to Saturday add new material it only touches: the acupoints one by one, a rehabilitation path from assessment to treatment (for example gluteal tendinopathy or hip osteoarthritis), a real case with spoken English, a paper, and test technique. They also drill the old material here: origins and insertions, nerves and levels, landmarks, ligaments and pronunciation.
text.zh: 这一章是周日的总览。周一到周六补充本章只点到的新内容：逐个精讲穴位、从检查到治疗的康复流程（例如臀肌腱病或髋骨关节炎）、带英文口语的真实病例、一篇论文和检查操作；同时反复练本章的旧内容：起止点、神经与节段、骨性标志、韧带和读音。

origin.en: Posterior gluteal surface of the ilium behind the posterior gluteal line, posterolateral sacrum and coccyx, thoracolumbar fascia and sacrotuberous ligament
origin.zh: 髂骨臀面臀后线后方、骶骨和尾骨后外侧面、胸腰筋膜及骶结节韧带

insertion.en: Iliotibial tract (superficial three quarters) and gluteal tuberosity of the femur (deep quarter)
insertion.zh: 髂胫束（浅层约四分之三）和股骨臀肌粗隆（深层约四分之一）

course.en: The gluteus maximus originates from the posterior ilium, sacrum, coccyx and sacrotuberous ligament, passes inferolaterally across the buttock superficial to the deep rotators, and inserts onto the iliotibial tract and the gluteal tuberosity of the femur.
course.zh: 臀大肌起自髂骨后部、骶骨、尾骨和骶结节韧带，向外下方斜行，覆盖在深层外旋肌浅面，止于髂胫束和股骨臀肌粗隆。

actions.en: It is the most powerful hip extensor and externally rotates the thigh, acting mainly when force is needed, such as rising from sitting, climbing stairs and running. Its upper fibres assist abduction and its lower fibres assist adduction, and through the iliotibial tract it helps stabilize the pelvis, femur and lateral knee in single-leg stance.
actions.zh: 它是最强有力的伸髋肌，并使大腿外旋，主要在需要用力时工作，例如从坐位起立、上楼梯和跑步。上部纤维协助外展，下部纤维协助内收；它还通过髂胫束在单腿站立时帮助稳定骨盆、股骨和膝外侧。

innervation.zh: 臀下神经（通常为 L5–S2）

origin.en: External (gluteal) surface of the ilium between the anterior and posterior gluteal lines
origin.zh: 髂骨外面（臀面）臀前线与臀后线之间

insertion.en: Lateral surface of the greater trochanter of the femur
insertion.zh: 股骨大转子外侧面

course.en: The gluteus medius originates from the gluteal surface of the ilium between the anterior and posterior gluteal lines, passes inferolaterally deep to the gluteus maximus as a fan that converges into a flat tendon, and inserts onto the lateral surface of the greater trochanter.
course.zh: 臀中肌起自髂骨臀面臀前线与臀后线之间，呈扇形在臀大肌深面向外下方汇聚成扁腱，止于股骨大转子外侧面。

actions.en: It is the primary hip abductor; its anterior fibres also internally rotate the thigh, and its posterior fibres assist external rotation. In single-leg stance and the stance phase of gait it holds the pelvis level over the supporting limb, and weakness lets the pelvis drop on the unsupported side, which is the Trendelenburg sign.
actions.zh: 它是主要的髋外展肌；前部纤维还使大腿内旋，后部纤维协助外旋。在单腿站立和步态支撑期，它把骨盆稳定在支撑腿上方保持水平；若无力，对侧（悬空侧）骨盆下沉，即 Trendelenburg 征。

innervation.zh: 臀上神经（通常为 L4–S1）

origin.en: External surface of the ilium between the anterior and inferior gluteal lines
origin.zh: 髂骨外面臀前线与臀下线之间

insertion.en: Anterior border (anterior aspect) of the greater trochanter of the femur
insertion.zh: 股骨大转子前缘（前面）

course.en: The gluteus minimus originates from the external surface of the ilium between the anterior and inferior gluteal lines, passes inferolaterally deep to the gluteus medius, and inserts onto the anterior aspect of the greater trochanter.
course.zh: 臀小肌起自髂骨外面臀前线与臀下线之间，在臀中肌深面向外下方走行，止于股骨大转子前面。

actions.en: It works with the gluteus medius to abduct the hip, and its anterior fibres internally rotate the thigh. In single-leg stance it contracts on the weight-bearing side to keep the pelvis level and stabilize the femoral head in the acetabulum.
actions.zh: 它与臀中肌协同外展髋关节，其前部纤维使大腿内旋。单腿站立时，它在负重侧收缩以保持骨盆水平，并把股骨头稳定在髋臼内。

innervation.zh: 臀上神经（通常为 L4–S1）

origin.en: Anterior superior iliac spine and the outer lip of the anterior iliac crest
origin.zh: 髂前上棘和髂嵴前部外唇

insertion.en: Iliotibial tract, which attaches to the lateral condyle of the tibia (Gerdy's tubercle)
insertion.zh: 髂胫束，后者附着于胫骨外侧髁（Gerdy 结节）

course.en: The tensor fasciae latae originates from the ASIS and the anterior iliac crest, passes inferiorly on the anterolateral thigh between the layers of the fascia lata, and inserts onto the iliotibial tract, which continues to the lateral condyle of the tibia.
course.zh: 阔筋膜张肌起自髂前上棘和髂嵴前部，在大腿前外侧于阔筋膜两层之间向下走行，止于髂胫束，再经髂胫束延续到胫骨外侧髁。

actions.en: It assists hip flexion, abduction and internal rotation, and keeps the iliotibial tract under tension to stabilize the hip and the lateral knee during stance.
actions.zh: 它协助屈髋、髋外展和髋内旋，并使髂胫束保持张力，在站立时稳定髋关节和膝外侧。

innervation.zh: 臀上神经（通常为 L4–S1）

origin.en: Anterior surface of the sacrum between the anterior sacral foramina (about S2–S4), with some fibres from the ilium near the PIIS and the sacrotuberous ligament
origin.zh: 骶骨前面骶前孔之间（约 S2–S4 水平），部分纤维起自髂后下棘附近的髂骨和骶结节韧带

insertion.en: Superior aspect (apex) of the greater trochanter of the femur
insertion.zh: 股骨大转子上缘（尖端）

course.en: The piriformis originates from the anterior surface of the sacrum, passes laterally out of the pelvis through the greater sciatic foramen, usually above the sciatic nerve, and inserts onto the superior aspect of the greater trochanter.
course.zh: 梨状肌起自骶骨前面，向外侧经坐骨大孔出盆腔，通常位于坐骨神经上方，止于股骨大转子上缘。

actions.en: With the hip extended it externally rotates the thigh, and with the hip flexed it abducts the thigh. When the hip is flexed beyond about 60 degrees, its line of pull crosses the rotation axis, so it acts as an internal rotator. It also helps hold the femoral head in the acetabulum.
actions.zh: 伸髋位时它使大腿外旋，屈髋位时使大腿外展。屈髋超过约 60° 时，其拉力线越过旋转轴，转而成为内旋肌。它还帮助把股骨头稳定在髋臼内。

innervation.zh: 梨状肌神经（通常为 S1–S2）

origin.en: Outer surface of the ischial spine
origin.zh: 坐骨棘外面

insertion.en: Medial surface of the greater trochanter, blending with the obturator internus tendon
insertion.zh: 股骨大转子内侧面，与闭孔内肌腱融合

course.en: The superior gemellus originates from the ischial spine, passes laterally along the upper border of the obturator internus tendon, and inserts onto the medial surface of the greater trochanter with that tendon.
course.zh: 上孖肌起自坐骨棘，沿闭孔内肌腱上缘向外侧走行，与该腱一起止于股骨大转子内侧面。

actions.en: It externally rotates the extended thigh and stabilizes the hip joint, and it assists abduction when the hip is flexed.
actions.zh: 它使伸直位的大腿外旋并稳定髋关节，屈髋时协助外展。

innervation.zh: 闭孔内肌神经（通常为 L5–S2）

origin.en: Inner (pelvic) surface of the obturator membrane and the bony margins of the obturator foramen (pubic and ischial rami)
origin.zh: 闭孔膜内面（盆面）及闭孔周围骨缘（耻骨支和坐骨支）

insertion.en: Medial surface of the greater trochanter of the femur, via a common tendon with the gemelli
insertion.zh: 股骨大转子内侧面，与上、下孖肌共腱

course.en: The obturator internus originates from the inner surface of the obturator membrane and surrounding bone, passes posteriorly and then turns sharply laterally around the lesser sciatic notch through the lesser sciatic foramen, and inserts onto the medial surface of the greater trochanter.
course.zh: 闭孔内肌起自闭孔膜内面及周围骨面，先向后走行，再绕坐骨小切迹急转向外经坐骨小孔出盆，止于股骨大转子内侧面。

actions.en: It externally rotates the extended thigh and abducts the flexed thigh, and acts as a postural stabilizer that holds the femoral head in the acetabulum, particularly when the hip is flexed.
actions.zh: 它使伸直位的大腿外旋、使屈曲位的大腿外展，并作为姿势稳定肌把股骨头稳定在髋臼内，屈髋时尤为明显。

innervation.zh: 闭孔内肌神经（通常为 L5–S2）

origin.en: Upper part of the ischial tuberosity
origin.zh: 坐骨结节上部

insertion.en: Medial surface of the greater trochanter, blending with the obturator internus tendon
insertion.zh: 股骨大转子内侧面，与闭孔内肌腱融合

course.en: The inferior gemellus originates from the upper ischial tuberosity, passes laterally along the lower border of the obturator internus tendon, and inserts onto the medial surface of the greater trochanter with that tendon.
course.zh: 下孖肌起自坐骨结节上部，沿闭孔内肌腱下缘向外侧走行，与该腱一起止于股骨大转子内侧面。

actions.en: It externally rotates the extended thigh and stabilizes the hip joint, and it assists abduction when the hip is flexed.
actions.zh: 它使伸直位的大腿外旋并稳定髋关节，屈髋时协助外展。

innervation.zh: 股方肌神经（通常为 L4–S1）

origin.en: Upper part of the lateral border of the ischial tuberosity
origin.zh: 坐骨结节外侧缘上部

insertion.en: Quadrate tubercle on the intertrochanteric crest of the femur
insertion.zh: 股骨转子间嵴上的股方肌结节

course.en: The quadratus femoris originates from the lateral border of the ischial tuberosity, passes horizontally laterally below the inferior gemellus and superficial to the obturator externus tendon, and inserts onto the quadrate tubercle of the intertrochanteric crest.
course.zh: 股方肌起自坐骨结节外侧缘，在下孖肌下方、闭孔外肌腱浅面水平向外侧走行，止于转子间嵴上的股方肌结节。

actions.en: It is mainly an external rotator of the thigh and helps hold the femoral head in the acetabulum. It weakly assists adduction in the anatomical position and abduction when the hip is flexed.
actions.zh: 它主要使大腿外旋，并帮助把股骨头稳定在髋臼内。在解剖位时它轻度协助内收，屈髋时协助外展。

innervation.zh: 股方肌神经（通常为 L4–S1）

origin.en: Outer surface of the obturator membrane and the surrounding pubic and ischial rami
origin.zh: 闭孔膜外面及周围的耻骨支和坐骨支

insertion.en: Trochanteric fossa of the femur
insertion.zh: 股骨转子窝

course.en: The obturator externus originates from the outer surface of the obturator membrane and surrounding bone, passes laterally below the acetabulum and behind the femoral neck, and inserts onto the trochanteric fossa of the femur.
course.zh: 闭孔外肌起自闭孔膜外面及周围骨面，向外侧经髋臼下方并绕到股骨颈后方，止于股骨转子窝。

actions.en: It externally rotates the extended thigh and abducts the flexed thigh, and together with the other short muscles it stabilizes the hip joint.
actions.zh: 它使伸直位的大腿外旋、使屈曲位的大腿外展，并与其他短肌一起稳定髋关节。

innervation.zh: 闭孔神经后支（通常为 L3–L4）

origin.en: Bodies of the T12–L4 vertebrae, the intervertebral discs between them, and the transverse processes of the lumbar vertebrae
origin.zh: T12–L4 椎体及其间的椎间盘，以及腰椎横突

insertion.en: Lesser trochanter of the femur, via the iliopsoas tendon
insertion.zh: 经髂腰肌腱止于股骨小转子

course.en: The psoas major originates from the bodies of the T12–L4 vertebrae, their intervertebral discs and the lumbar transverse processes, passes inferolaterally along the pelvic brim and beneath the inguinal ligament, where it joins the iliacus, and inserts onto the lesser trochanter of the femur via the iliopsoas tendon.
course.zh: 腰大肌起自 T12–L4 椎体、其间的椎间盘及腰椎横突，沿骨盆缘向外下方走行，经腹股沟韧带深面并与髂肌汇合，以髂腰肌腱止于股骨小转子。

actions.en: It is a main flexor of the hip, flexing the thigh on the trunk or the trunk on the thigh, and it also laterally flexes the lumbar spine.
actions.zh: 它是髋关节的主要屈肌，可使大腿向躯干屈曲，或使躯干向大腿屈曲，还能使腰椎侧屈。

innervation.en: Anterior rami of the lumbar spinal nerves, usually L1–L3
innervation.zh: 腰神经前支（通常为 L1–L3）

modelUnavailableReason.en: Not in the bundled 3D model yet; it will be added from the Z-Anatomy source.
modelUnavailableReason.zh: 随附 3D 模型暂无此肌肉，之后从 Z-Anatomy 源模型补入。

origin.en: Superior two-thirds of the iliac fossa, the inner lip of the iliac crest and the ala of the sacrum
origin.zh: 髂窝上 2/3、髂嵴内唇及骶骨翼

insertion.en: Lesser trochanter of the femur, via the iliopsoas tendon
insertion.zh: 经髂腰肌腱止于股骨小转子

course.en: The iliacus originates from the iliac fossa, passes inferiorly beneath the inguinal ligament lateral to the psoas major, whose tendon it joins, and inserts onto the lesser trochanter of the femur via the iliopsoas tendon.
course.zh: 髂肌起自髂窝，向下经腹股沟韧带深面、位于腰大肌外侧并与其肌腱汇合，以髂腰肌腱止于股骨小转子。

actions.en: Together with the psoas major, it flexes the hip; with the femur fixed, it helps bring the trunk and pelvis forward.
actions.zh: 它与腰大肌共同屈髋；股骨固定时，它帮助把躯干和骨盆向前拉。

innervation.zh: 股神经（通常为 L2–L4）

modelUnavailableReason.en: Not in the bundled 3D model yet; it will be added from the Z-Anatomy source.
modelUnavailableReason.zh: 随附 3D 模型暂无此肌肉，之后从 Z-Anatomy 源模型补入。

origin.en: Anterior superior iliac spine (ASIS) and the upper part of the notch below it
origin.zh: 髂前上棘（ASIS）及其下方切迹的上部

insertion.en: Superior medial surface of the tibia, as part of the pes anserinus
insertion.zh: 胫骨上端内侧面，参与构成鹅足

course.en: The sartorius originates from the anterior superior iliac spine, passes obliquely inferomedially across the anterior thigh and behind the medial femoral condyle, and inserts onto the superior medial surface of the tibia as part of the pes anserinus.
course.zh: 缝匠肌起自髂前上棘，斜向内下方越过大腿前面，经股骨内侧髁后方，止于胫骨上端内侧面，参与构成鹅足。

actions.en: At the hip, it flexes, abducts and laterally rotates the thigh; at the knee, it flexes the leg and helps medially rotate the tibia.
actions.zh: 在髋关节，它使大腿屈曲、外展和外旋；在膝关节，它使小腿屈曲，并协助胫骨内旋。

innervation.zh: 股神经（通常为 L2–L3）

modelUnavailableReason.en: Not in the bundled 3D model yet; it will be added from the Z-Anatomy source.
modelUnavailableReason.zh: 随附 3D 模型暂无此肌肉，之后从 Z-Anatomy 源模型补入。

origin.en: Straight head from the anterior inferior iliac spine (AIIS); reflected head from the supra-acetabular groove of the ilium
origin.zh: 直头起自髂前下棘（AIIS），反折头起自髂骨的髋臼上沟

insertion.en: Base of the patella via the quadriceps tendon, and then the tibial tuberosity via the patellar ligament
insertion.zh: 经股四头肌腱止于髌骨底，再经髌韧带止于胫骨粗隆

course.en: The rectus femoris originates from the anterior inferior iliac spine and the supra-acetabular groove, passes straight down the front of the thigh over the hip and knee joints, and inserts onto the patella via the quadriceps tendon and onto the tibial tuberosity via the patellar ligament.
course.zh: 股直肌起自髂前下棘和髋臼上沟，沿大腿前面垂直向下，跨过髋关节和膝关节，经股四头肌腱止于髌骨，再经髌韧带止于胫骨粗隆。

actions.en: It assists flexion of the hip and is a strong extensor of the knee.
actions.zh: 它协助屈髋，同时是强有力的伸膝肌。

innervation.zh: 股神经（通常为 L2–L4）

modelUnavailableReason.en: Not in the bundled 3D model yet; it will be added from the Z-Anatomy source.
modelUnavailableReason.zh: 随附 3D 模型暂无此肌肉，之后从 Z-Anatomy 源模型补入。

origin.en: Pectineal line of the superior pubic ramus
origin.zh: 耻骨上支的耻骨梳

insertion.en: Pectineal line of the femur, just below the lesser trochanter
insertion.zh: 股骨耻骨肌线，紧邻小转子下方

course.en: The pectineus originates from the pectineal line of the superior pubic ramus, passes inferolaterally and posteriorly in the floor of the femoral triangle, and inserts onto the pectineal line of the femur just below the lesser trochanter.
course.zh: 耻骨肌起自耻骨上支的耻骨梳，在股三角底部向外下后方走行，止于小转子下方的股骨耻骨肌线。

actions.en: It adducts and flexes the thigh at the hip and helps stabilize the pelvis.
actions.zh: 它在髋关节使大腿内收和屈曲，并帮助稳定骨盆。

innervation.en: Usually dual: femoral nerve (usually L2–L3) as the main supply, with a branch of the obturator or accessory obturator nerve to the posterior part in some people
innervation.zh: 常为双重支配：主要由股神经（通常为 L2–L3）支配，部分人群其后部另有闭孔神经或副闭孔神经分支支配
