origin.en: Body of the pubis, below the pubic crest and lateral to the pubic symphysis
origin.zh: 耻骨体，位于耻骨嵴下方、耻骨联合外侧

insertion.en: Middle third of the medial lip of the linea aspera of the femur
insertion.zh: 股骨粗线内侧唇中 1/3

course.en: The adductor longus originates from the body of the pubis below the pubic crest, passes inferolaterally as a fan-shaped belly forming the medial border of the femoral triangle, and inserts onto the middle third of the linea aspera of the femur.
course.zh: 长收肌起自耻骨嵴下方的耻骨体，以扇形肌腹向外下方走行，构成股三角内侧界，止于股骨粗线中 1/3。

actions.en: It adducts the thigh at the hip and assists hip flexion.
actions.zh: 它在髋关节内收大腿，并协助屈髋。

innervation.en: Anterior division of the obturator nerve (usually L2–L4)
innervation.zh: 闭孔神经前支（通常为 L2–L4）

modelUnavailableReason.en: Not in the bundled 3D model yet; it will be added from the Z-Anatomy source.
modelUnavailableReason.zh: 随附 3D 模型暂无此肌肉，之后从 Z-Anatomy 源模型补入。

origin.en: Body of the pubis and the inferior pubic ramus
origin.zh: 耻骨体和耻骨下支

insertion.en: Superior part of the linea aspera of the femur, proximal to the adductor longus
insertion.zh: 股骨粗线上部，位于长收肌止点近侧

course.en: The adductor brevis originates from the body of the pubis and the inferior pubic ramus, passes inferolaterally deep to the pectineus and adductor longus, and inserts onto the upper part of the linea aspera of the femur.
course.zh: 短收肌起自耻骨体和耻骨下支，在耻骨肌和长收肌深面向外下方走行，止于股骨粗线上部。

actions.en: It adducts the thigh at the hip and assists hip flexion.
actions.zh: 它在髋关节内收大腿，并协助屈髋。

innervation.zh: 闭孔神经（通常为 L2–L4）

modelUnavailableReason.en: Not in the bundled 3D model yet; it will be added from the Z-Anatomy source.
modelUnavailableReason.zh: 随附 3D 模型暂无此肌肉，之后从 Z-Anatomy 源模型补入。

origin.en: Adductor part from the inferior pubic ramus and ischial ramus; hamstring part from the ischial tuberosity
origin.zh: 收肌部起自耻骨下支和坐骨支，腘绳肌部起自坐骨结节

insertion.en: Adductor part onto the gluteal tuberosity, linea aspera and medial supracondylar line; hamstring part onto the adductor tubercle of the femur
insertion.zh: 收肌部止于臀肌粗隆、股骨粗线和内侧髁上线，腘绳肌部止于股骨收肌结节

course.en: The adductor magnus originates from the inferior pubic ramus, ischial ramus and ischial tuberosity, passes inferolaterally as the deepest and largest medial thigh muscle, leaving the adductor hiatus between its two insertions, and inserts onto the linea aspera, medial supracondylar line and adductor tubercle of the femur.
course.zh: 大收肌起自耻骨下支、坐骨支和坐骨结节，作为大腿内侧最深、最大的肌肉向外下方走行，两部分止点之间留有收肌腱裂孔，止于股骨粗线、内侧髁上线和收肌结节。

actions.en: The whole muscle adducts the thigh at the hip; the adductor part also flexes the hip, while the hamstring part extends it.
actions.zh: 整块肌肉在髋关节内收大腿；其中收肌部还能屈髋，腘绳肌部则伸髋。

innervation.en: Dual: the adductor part is supplied by the obturator nerve (usually L2–L4), and the hamstring part by the tibial division of the sciatic nerve (usually L4)
innervation.zh: 双重支配：收肌部由闭孔神经（通常为 L2–L4）支配，腘绳肌部由坐骨神经胫神经部（通常为 L4）支配

modelUnavailableReason.en: Not in the bundled 3D model yet; it will be added from the Z-Anatomy source.
modelUnavailableReason.zh: 随附 3D 模型暂无此肌肉，之后从 Z-Anatomy 源模型补入。

origin.en: Lower half of the body of the pubis and the inferior pubic ramus
origin.zh: 耻骨体下半部和耻骨下支

insertion.en: Superior medial surface of the tibia, as part of the pes anserinus
insertion.zh: 胫骨上端内侧面，参与构成鹅足

course.en: The gracilis originates from the body of the pubis and the inferior pubic ramus, passes vertically down the medial side of the thigh and behind the medial femoral condyle, and inserts onto the superior medial surface of the tibia as part of the pes anserinus.
course.zh: 股薄肌起自耻骨体和耻骨下支，沿大腿内侧垂直下行，经股骨内侧髁后方，止于胫骨上端内侧面，参与构成鹅足。

actions.en: At the hip, it adducts the thigh; at the knee, it flexes the leg and medially rotates it when the knee is flexed.
actions.zh: 在髋关节，它内收大腿；在膝关节，它使小腿屈曲，并在屈膝时使小腿内旋。

innervation.zh: 闭孔神经（通常为 L2–L3）

modelUnavailableReason.en: Not in the bundled 3D model yet; it will be added from the Z-Anatomy source.
modelUnavailableReason.zh: 随附 3D 模型暂无此肌肉，之后从 Z-Anatomy 源模型补入。

origin.en: Long head from the ischial tuberosity and sacrotuberous ligament; short head from the lateral lip of the linea aspera and the lateral supracondylar line of the femur
origin.zh: 长头起自坐骨结节和骶结节韧带，短头起自股骨粗线外侧唇和外侧髁上线

insertion.en: Lateral side of the head of the fibula
insertion.zh: 腓骨头外侧

course.en: The biceps femoris originates from the ischial tuberosity (long head) and the linea aspera of the femur (short head), passes inferolaterally down the posterior thigh to form the lateral border of the popliteal fossa, and inserts onto the head of the fibula.
course.zh: 股二头肌长头起自坐骨结节，短头起自股骨粗线，沿大腿后面向外下方走行，构成腘窝外上界，止于腓骨头。

actions.en: The long head, the hip-acting part, extends the hip; both heads flex the knee and laterally rotate the leg when the knee is flexed.
actions.zh: 长头是作用于髋关节的部分，可伸髋；两个头都能屈膝，并在屈膝时使小腿外旋。

innervation.en: Long head: tibial division of the sciatic nerve; short head: common fibular division of the sciatic nerve; both usually L5–S2
innervation.zh: 长头由坐骨神经胫神经部支配，短头由坐骨神经腓总神经部支配，二者通常均为 L5–S2

modelUnavailableReason.en: Not in the bundled 3D model yet; it will be added from the Z-Anatomy source.
modelUnavailableReason.zh: 随附 3D 模型暂无此肌肉，之后从 Z-Anatomy 源模型补入。

origin.en: Ischial tuberosity, by a tendon shared with the long head of the biceps femoris
origin.zh: 坐骨结节，与股二头肌长头共腱起始

insertion.en: Superior medial surface of the tibia, as part of the pes anserinus
insertion.zh: 胫骨上端内侧面，参与构成鹅足

course.en: The semitendinosus originates from the ischial tuberosity, passes inferomedially down the posterior thigh, becoming a long tendon superficial to the semimembranosus, and inserts onto the superior medial surface of the tibia as part of the pes anserinus.
course.zh: 半腱肌起自坐骨结节，沿大腿后面向内下方走行，在半膜肌浅面移行为细长肌腱，止于胫骨上端内侧面，参与构成鹅足。

actions.en: At the hip, it extends the thigh; at the knee, it flexes the leg and medially rotates it when the knee is flexed.
actions.zh: 在髋关节，它伸大腿；在膝关节，它使小腿屈曲，并在屈膝时使小腿内旋。

innervation.en: Tibial division of the sciatic nerve (usually L5–S2)
innervation.zh: 坐骨神经胫神经部（通常为 L5–S2）

modelUnavailableReason.en: Not in the bundled 3D model yet; it will be added from the Z-Anatomy source.
modelUnavailableReason.zh: 随附 3D 模型暂无此肌肉，之后从 Z-Anatomy 源模型补入。

origin.en: Superolateral impression of the ischial tuberosity
origin.zh: 坐骨结节上外侧压迹

insertion.en: Posterior surface of the medial condyle of the tibia, with expansions forming the oblique popliteal ligament
insertion.zh: 胫骨内侧髁后面，并发出扩展部形成腘斜韧带

course.en: The semimembranosus originates from the ischial tuberosity, passes inferomedially down the posterior thigh deep to the semitendinosus as a flat membranous tendon becoming a thick belly, and inserts onto the posterior surface of the medial tibial condyle.
course.zh: 半膜肌起自坐骨结节，以扁平的膜状腱起始并移行为厚实肌腹，在半腱肌深面沿大腿后面向内下方走行，止于胫骨内侧髁后面。

actions.en: At the hip, it extends the thigh; at the knee, it flexes the leg and medially rotates it when the knee is flexed.
actions.zh: 在髋关节，它伸大腿；在膝关节，它使小腿屈曲，并在屈膝时使小腿内旋。

innervation.en: Tibial division of the sciatic nerve (usually L5–S2)
innervation.zh: 坐骨神经胫神经部（通常为 L5–S2）

description.en: The ilium is the largest and most superior of the three parts of the hip bone, and its lower body forms the upper part of the acetabulum. Its fan-shaped wing carries the iliac fossa on the inner surface, where the iliacus arises, and the gluteal surface on the outer side, where the gluteal muscles arise. The iliac crest, the anterior and posterior iliac spines and the greater sciatic notch all belong to the ilium.
description.zh: 髂骨是髋骨三部分中最大、位置最高的一块，其下部（髂骨体）构成髋臼的上部。扇形的髂骨翼内面是髂窝，为髂肌起点；外面是臀面，为臀肌起点。髂嵴、髂前上棘、髂前下棘、髂后上棘和坐骨大切迹都属于髂骨。

modelUnavailableReason.en: The 3D model shows the whole bone; this landmark has no separate marker yet.
modelUnavailableReason.zh: 3D 模型只显示整块骨，这个骨性标志暂无单独标记。

description.en: The ischium forms the posteroinferior part of the hip bone; its body contributes the posterior part of the acetabulum and its ramus joins the inferior pubic ramus. Its main landmarks are the ischial spine, the lesser sciatic notch and the ischial tuberosity. The hamstrings, adductor magnus and inferior gemellus attach to the ischial tuberosity, and the sacrospinous ligament attaches to the ischial spine.
description.zh: 坐骨构成髋骨的后下部；坐骨体参与构成髋臼后部，坐骨支与耻骨下支相连。主要标志有坐骨棘、坐骨小切迹和坐骨结节。腘绳肌、大收肌和下孖肌附着于坐骨结节，骶棘韧带附着于坐骨棘。

modelUnavailableReason.en: The 3D model shows the whole bone; this landmark has no separate marker yet.
modelUnavailableReason.zh: 3D 模型只显示整块骨，这个骨性标志暂无单独标记。

description.en: The pubis forms the anterior part of the hip bone and consists of a body and superior and inferior rami; the two pubic bones meet at the pubic symphysis. The superior ramus contributes to the acetabulum, and the two rami together with the ischium enclose the obturator foramen. Pectineus, adductor longus, adductor brevis, gracilis and part of adductor magnus arise from the pubis, and the pubic tubercle receives the medial end of the inguinal ligament.
description.zh: 耻骨构成髋骨前部，由耻骨体和耻骨上、下支组成，两侧耻骨在耻骨联合处相连。耻骨上支参与构成髋臼，两支与坐骨一起围成闭孔。耻骨肌、长收肌、短收肌、股薄肌和部分大收肌起自耻骨，耻骨结节是腹股沟韧带内侧端的附着点。

modelUnavailableReason.en: The 3D model shows the whole bone; this landmark has no separate marker yet.
modelUnavailableReason.zh: 3D 模型只显示整块骨，这个骨性标志暂无单独标记。

description.en: The iliac crest is the thickened upper border of the iliac wing, running from the anterior superior iliac spine to the posterior superior iliac spine, and it is easily palpated at the waist. It gives attachment to muscles and fascia of the abdominal wall, the back and the lower limb. Tensor fasciae latae arises from the outer lip of its anterior part, and the iliotibial tract attaches near the iliac tubercle.
description.zh: 髂嵴是髂骨翼增厚的上缘，从髂前上棘延伸到髂后上棘，在腰部很容易摸到。它是腹壁、背部和下肢肌肉及筋膜的附着处。阔筋膜张肌起自其前部外唇，髂胫束附着于髂结节附近。

modelUnavailableReason.en: The 3D model shows the whole bone; this landmark has no separate marker yet.
modelUnavailableReason.zh: 3D 模型只显示整块骨，这个骨性标志暂无单独标记。

description.en: The anterior superior iliac spine is the rounded anterior end of the iliac crest and is an easily palpated landmark at the front of the hip. Sartorius and tensor fasciae latae arise here, and the lateral end of the inguinal ligament attaches to it. The lateral femoral cutaneous nerve usually passes into the thigh just medial to it.
description.zh: 髂前上棘是髂嵴前端的圆形突起，是髋前方容易摸到的骨性标志。缝匠肌和阔筋膜张肌起于此处，腹股沟韧带外侧端也附着于此。股外侧皮神经通常在它内侧不远处进入大腿。

modelUnavailableReason.en: The 3D model shows the whole bone; this landmark has no separate marker yet.
modelUnavailableReason.zh: 3D 模型只显示整块骨，这个骨性标志暂无单独标记。

description.en: The anterior inferior iliac spine is a smaller projection on the anterior border of the ilium, below the anterior superior iliac spine and just above the acetabulum. The straight head of rectus femoris arises from it. The upper part of the iliofemoral ligament also attaches here.
description.zh: 髂前下棘是髂骨前缘上一个较小的突起，位于髂前上棘下方、髋臼正上方。股直肌直头起自此处。髂股韧带的上部也附着于此。

modelUnavailableReason.en: The 3D model shows the whole bone; this landmark has no separate marker yet.
modelUnavailableReason.zh: 3D 模型只显示整块骨，这个骨性标志暂无单独标记。

description.en: The posterior superior iliac spine is the posterior end of the iliac crest and usually shows on the skin as a dimple above the buttock. A line joining the two spines crosses the sacroiliac joints at about the level of S2. Strong posterior sacroiliac ligaments and part of the sacrotuberous ligament attach in this region.
description.zh: 髂后上棘是髂嵴的后端，皮肤表面通常表现为臀部上方的小凹陷。两侧髂后上棘的连线大约在 S2 水平经过骶髂关节。强大的骶髂后韧带和部分骶结节韧带附着在这一区域。

modelUnavailableReason.en: The 3D model shows the whole bone; this landmark has no separate marker yet.
modelUnavailableReason.zh: 3D 模型只显示整块骨，这个骨性标志暂无单独标记。

description.en: The iliac fossa is the large, smooth concavity on the inner surface of the iliac wing and forms the posterolateral wall of the greater pelvis. The iliacus arises from it. The femoral nerve and the lateral femoral cutaneous nerve run across the iliacus within the fossa on their way to the thigh.
description.zh: 髂窝是髂骨翼内面宽大光滑的凹面，构成大骨盆的后外侧壁。髂肌起自髂窝。股神经和股外侧皮神经在髂窝内越过髂肌表面，向大腿走行。

modelUnavailableReason.en: The 3D model shows the whole bone; this landmark has no separate marker yet.
modelUnavailableReason.zh: 3D 模型只显示整块骨，这个骨性标志暂无单独标记。

description.en: The acetabulum is the cup-shaped socket on the lateral side of the hip bone, formed where the ilium, ischium and pubis meet. It articulates with the femoral head to form the hip joint. Its rim is deepened by the fibrocartilaginous acetabular labrum, and the gap at the inferior acetabular notch is bridged by the transverse acetabular ligament.
description.zh: 髋臼是髋骨外侧面的杯状窝，由髂骨、坐骨和耻骨三者会合而成。它与股骨头相关节，构成髋关节。髋臼缘由纤维软骨性的髋臼唇加深，下方的髋臼切迹由髋臼横韧带跨越。

modelUnavailableReason.en: The 3D model shows the whole bone; this landmark has no separate marker yet.
modelUnavailableReason.zh: 3D 模型只显示整块骨，这个骨性标志暂无单独标记。

description.en: The greater sciatic foramen is the opening formed when the sacrospinous and sacrotuberous ligaments convert the greater sciatic notch into a foramen. Piriformis passes through it and divides it into a part above and a part below the muscle. The superior gluteal nerve and vessels pass above piriformis, while the sciatic, inferior gluteal, pudendal and posterior femoral cutaneous nerves, the nerves to obturator internus and quadratus femoris, and the inferior gluteal vessels pass below it.
description.zh: 坐骨大孔是坐骨大切迹被骶棘韧带和骶结节韧带围成的孔。梨状肌穿过此孔，把它分成梨状肌上孔和梨状肌下孔。臀上神经和臀上血管经梨状肌上方穿出；坐骨神经、臀下神经、阴部神经、股后皮神经、闭孔内肌神经、股方肌神经以及臀下血管经梨状肌下方穿出。

modelUnavailableReason.en: The 3D model shows the whole bone; this landmark has no separate marker yet.
modelUnavailableReason.zh: 3D 模型只显示整块骨，这个骨性标志暂无单独标记。

description.en: The lesser sciatic foramen lies below the ischial spine, bounded by the lesser sciatic notch, the sacrospinous ligament above and the sacrotuberous ligament behind. The tendon of obturator internus leaves the pelvis through it. The pudendal nerve, the internal pudendal vessels and the nerve to obturator internus re-enter through it after hooking around the ischial spine or sacrospinous ligament.
description.zh: 坐骨小孔位于坐骨棘下方，由坐骨小切迹、上方的骶棘韧带和后方的骶结节韧带围成。闭孔内肌腱经此孔出骨盆。阴部神经、阴部内血管和闭孔内肌神经绕过坐骨棘或骶棘韧带后经此孔重新进入。

modelUnavailableReason.en: The 3D model shows the whole bone; this landmark has no separate marker yet.
modelUnavailableReason.zh: 3D 模型只显示整块骨，这个骨性标志暂无单独标记。

description.en: The obturator foramen is the large opening below the acetabulum, enclosed by the pubic rami and the ischium. It is almost entirely closed by the obturator membrane, which gives origin to obturator internus on its inner side and obturator externus on its outer side. A small gap at its upper edge, the obturator canal, transmits the obturator nerve, artery and vein into the medial thigh.
description.zh: 闭孔是髋臼下方的大孔，由耻骨上下支和坐骨围成。它几乎完全被闭孔膜封闭，闭孔膜内面是闭孔内肌的起点，外面是闭孔外肌的起点。上缘留有一个小通道，即闭膜管，闭孔神经、闭孔动脉和闭孔静脉经此进入大腿内侧。

modelUnavailableReason.en: The 3D model shows the whole bone; this landmark has no separate marker yet.
modelUnavailableReason.zh: 3D 模型只显示整块骨，这个骨性标志暂无单独标记。

description.en: The ischial tuberosity is the large rough prominence at the posteroinferior ischium that bears body weight in sitting. Semitendinosus, semimembranosus, the long head of biceps femoris and the ischial (hamstring) part of adductor magnus arise from it. The sacrotuberous ligament and the inferior gemellus also attach here.
description.zh: 坐骨结节是坐骨后下部粗大的隆起，坐位时承受体重。半腱肌、半膜肌、股二头肌长头和大收肌的坐骨部（腘绳肌部）起于此处。骶结节韧带和下孖肌也附着于此。

modelUnavailableReason.en: The 3D model shows the whole bone; this landmark has no separate marker yet.
modelUnavailableReason.zh: 3D 模型只显示整块骨，这个骨性标志暂无单独标记。

description.en: The pubic tubercle is a small projection at the lateral end of the pubic crest on the upper border of the pubic body. The medial end of the inguinal ligament attaches to it, so it is a useful landmark for the groin. Adductor longus arises from the pubic body just below it.
description.zh: 耻骨结节是耻骨体上缘、耻骨嵴外侧端的小突起。腹股沟韧带的内侧端附着于此，因此它是腹股沟区的重要标志。长收肌起自其下方的耻骨体。

modelUnavailableReason.en: The 3D model shows the whole bone; this landmark has no separate marker yet.
modelUnavailableReason.zh: 3D 模型只显示整块骨，这个骨性标志暂无单独标记。

description.en: The ischiopubic ramus is the bar of bone formed where the inferior pubic ramus joins the ramus of the ischium, forming the lower border of the obturator foramen. Gracilis, adductor brevis and the adductor part of adductor magnus arise along it. Obturator externus arises from its outer surface near the margin of the obturator foramen.
description.zh: 坐耻支是耻骨下支与坐骨支相连形成的骨条，构成闭孔的下缘。股薄肌、短收肌和大收肌的收肌部沿其起始。闭孔外肌起自它靠近闭孔边缘的外面。

description.en: The femoral head is the rounded proximal end of the femur that fits into the acetabulum to form the hip joint. It is covered by articular cartilage except at the fovea, a small pit where the ligament of the head of the femur attaches. Most of its blood supply comes from retinacular branches of the medial circumflex femoral artery.
description.zh: 股骨头是股骨近端的球形部分，嵌入髋臼构成髋关节。除股骨头凹外，其表面都覆盖着关节软骨；股骨头凹是股骨头韧带的附着处。它的血供主要来自旋股内侧动脉的支持带分支。

modelUnavailableReason.en: The 3D model shows the whole bone; this landmark has no separate marker yet.
modelUnavailableReason.zh: 3D 模型只显示整块骨，这个骨性标志暂无单独标记。

description.en: The femoral neck joins the head to the shaft at an angle of inclination of about 130 degrees and is usually anteverted about 10–15 degrees. The hip joint capsule attaches to the intertrochanteric line anteriorly and to the neck posteriorly. Retinacular vessels run along the neck to the head, so displaced neck fractures can cause avascular necrosis of the femoral head.
description.zh: 股骨颈连接股骨头和股骨干，颈干角约 130°，通常前倾约 10–15°。髋关节囊前方附着于转子间线，后方附着于股骨颈。支持带血管沿股骨颈走向股骨头，因此移位的股骨颈骨折可导致股骨头缺血性坏死。

modelUnavailableReason.en: The 3D model shows the whole bone; this landmark has no separate marker yet.
modelUnavailableReason.zh: 3D 模型只显示整块骨，这个骨性标志暂无单独标记。

description.en: The greater trochanter is the large lateral projection at the junction of the femoral neck and shaft and is palpable on the side of the hip. Gluteus medius inserts on its lateral surface, gluteus minimus on its anterior surface, piriformis on its apex, and obturator internus with the gemelli on its medial surface. Vastus lateralis arises from its lower part.
description.zh: 大转子是股骨颈与股骨干交界处外侧的大突起，在髋外侧可以摸到。臀中肌止于其外侧面，臀小肌止于其前面，梨状肌止于其尖端，闭孔内肌和上下孖肌止于其内侧面。股外侧肌起自其下部。

modelUnavailableReason.en: The 3D model shows the whole bone; this landmark has no separate marker yet.
modelUnavailableReason.zh: 3D 模型只显示整块骨，这个骨性标志暂无单独标记。

description.en: The lesser trochanter is a conical projection on the posteromedial side of the femur, just below the junction of the neck and shaft. The iliopsoas, formed by psoas major and iliacus, inserts onto it. It is linked to the greater trochanter by the intertrochanteric crest behind.
description.zh: 小转子是股骨后内侧、股骨颈与股骨干交界处稍下方的圆锥形突起。由腰大肌和髂肌组成的髂腰肌止于此处。它在后方通过转子间嵴与大转子相连。

modelUnavailableReason.en: The 3D model shows the whole bone; this landmark has no separate marker yet.
modelUnavailableReason.zh: 3D 模型只显示整块骨，这个骨性标志暂无单独标记。

description.en: The intertrochanteric crest is the prominent ridge on the posterior femur joining the greater and lesser trochanters. A rounded elevation on it, the quadrate tubercle, receives the insertion of quadratus femoris. The intertrochanteric line is the smoother anterior counterpart, where the iliofemoral ligament attaches.
description.zh: 转子间嵴是股骨后面连接大、小转子的明显骨嵴。嵴上的圆形隆起称为股方肌结节，是股方肌的止点。前方对应的较平滑的骨线是转子间线，髂股韧带附着于此。

modelUnavailableReason.en: The 3D model shows the whole bone; this landmark has no separate marker yet.
modelUnavailableReason.zh: 3D 模型只显示整块骨，这个骨性标志暂无单独标记。

description.en: The gluteal tuberosity is a broad rough ridge on the upper posterior shaft of the femur, running down from the base of the greater trochanter toward the linea aspera. The deep fibres of gluteus maximus insert onto it. Most of the superficial fibres of gluteus maximus instead insert into the iliotibial tract.
description.zh: 臀肌粗隆是股骨干上段后面一条宽阔粗糙的骨嵴，从大转子基部向下延续到粗线。臀大肌深层纤维止于此处。臀大肌浅层的大部分纤维则止于髂胫束。

modelUnavailableReason.en: The 3D model shows the whole bone; this landmark has no separate marker yet.
modelUnavailableReason.zh: 3D 模型只显示整块骨，这个骨性标志暂无单独标记。

description.en: The linea aspera is the rough longitudinal ridge on the posterior middle third of the femoral shaft, with a medial and a lateral lip. Adductor longus, adductor brevis and the adductor part of adductor magnus insert along it, while vastus medialis, vastus lateralis and the short head of biceps femoris arise from its lips. Above it diverges toward the gluteal tuberosity and pectineal line, and below it splits into the supracondylar lines.
description.zh: 粗线是股骨干中 1/3 后面一条粗糙的纵行骨嵴，分为内侧唇和外侧唇。长收肌、短收肌和大收肌收肌部沿其止于此，股内侧肌、股外侧肌和股二头肌短头起自其两唇。它向上分开延续为臀肌粗隆和耻骨肌线，向下分为内、外侧髁上线。

modelUnavailableReason.zh: 3D 模型只显示整块骨，这个骨性标志暂无单独标记。

description.en: The adductor tubercle is a small bony projection on the upper part of the medial femoral condyle, at the lower end of the medial supracondylar line. The tendon of the ischiocondylar (hamstring) part of adductor magnus inserts onto it. It is a palpable landmark on the medial side of the distal thigh.
description.zh: 收肌结节是股骨内侧髁上部、内侧髁上线下端的小骨突。大收肌坐骨髁部（腘绳肌部）的肌腱止于此处。它是大腿远端内侧可以摸到的骨性标志。

modelUnavailableReason.en: The 3D model shows the whole bone; this landmark has no separate marker yet.
modelUnavailableReason.zh: 3D 模型只显示整块骨，这个骨性标志暂无单独标记。

description.en: The iliotibial tract is a thickened band of the fascia lata on the lateral thigh, running from the iliac crest near the iliac tubercle to Gerdy's tubercle on the lateral condyle of the tibia. Tensor fasciae latae and most of the superficial fibres of gluteus maximus insert into it, so it transmits their pull to the knee. It helps stabilize the lateral hip and knee and is not itself a bony landmark.
description.zh: 髂胫束是大腿外侧阔筋膜增厚形成的纤维带，从髂结节附近的髂嵴延伸到胫骨外侧髁的 Gerdy 结节。阔筋膜张肌和臀大肌浅层的大部分纤维止于其中，因此它把这两块肌肉的拉力传到膝部。它帮助稳定髋和膝的外侧，本身并不是骨性标志。

question.en: Name the five muscle groups of the hip and the main action of each.
question.zh: 说出髋部五组肌肉以及各组的主要动作。

answer.en: The gluteal group extends and abducts the hip and steadies the pelvis in stance. The deep lateral rotators turn the thigh outwards and hold the femoral head in the acetabulum. The anterior group, led by iliopsoas, flexes the hip. The medial group adducts the hip. The posterior group, the hamstrings, extends the hip and flexes the knee.
answer.zh: 臀肌群伸髋、外展，并在站立时稳定骨盆。深层外旋肌使大腿外旋，并把股骨头稳定在髋臼内。以髂腰肌为首的前群屈髋。内侧群使髋内收。后群即腘绳肌，伸髋并屈膝。

question.en: Which muscles does the superior gluteal nerve supply, and what do you see when it is injured?
question.zh: 臀上神经支配哪些肌肉？损伤后会看到什么？

answer.en: The superior gluteal nerve, usually L4–S1, leaves the pelvis above piriformis and supplies gluteus medius, gluteus minimus and tensor fasciae latae. When it is injured the hip abductors are weak, so during stance on the affected leg the pelvis drops on the swing side; this is a positive Trendelenburg sign.
answer.zh: 臀上神经通常来自 L4–S1，在梨状肌上方出盆，支配臀中肌、臀小肌和阔筋膜张肌。损伤后髋外展肌无力，患侧单腿站立时摆动侧骨盆下沉，即 Trendelenburg 征阳性。

question.en: How does the sciatic nerve relate to piriformis, and why does it matter?
question.zh: 坐骨神经与梨状肌是什么关系？为什么重要？

answer.en: In most people the sciatic nerve leaves the pelvis through the greater sciatic foramen below piriformis and then crosses the gemelli, obturator internus and quadratus femoris. In a minority, part of the nerve, usually the common fibular division, passes through or above the muscle. This close relationship is why piriformis and the deep rotators are considered in deep gluteal pain with sciatic symptoms.
answer.zh: 多数人的坐骨神经经坐骨大孔、在梨状肌下方出盆，然后越过孖肌、闭孔内肌和股方肌。少数人有一部分神经（通常是腓总神经部分）穿过梨状肌或从其上方走行。正因为关系这么近，臀深部疼痛伴坐骨神经症状时要考虑梨状肌和深层外旋肌。

question.en: Why must the hip abductors pull much harder than body weight in single-leg stance?
question.zh: 为什么单腿站立时髋外展肌的拉力要远大于体重？

answer.en: In single-leg stance the femoral head is the fulcrum. Body weight acts near the midline, about two and a half times farther from the fulcrum than the abductors, which pull on the greater trochanter. To balance the moments, gluteus medius and minimus must pull with roughly one and a half to two and a half times body weight, and the joint reaction force rises to about two and a half times body weight.
answer.zh: 单腿站立时股骨头是支点。体重作用在中线附近，到支点的距离约是外展肌（拉在大转子上）的 2.5 倍。为了平衡力矩，臀中肌和臀小肌的拉力约为体重的 1.6 到 2.5 倍，关节反作用力升到约 2.5 倍体重。

question.en: What happens to the action of piriformis when the hip is flexed past about 60 degrees?
question.zh: 髋屈曲超过约 60° 时，梨状肌的作用会怎样变化？

answer.en: With the hip extended, piriformis passes behind the long axis of the femur and rotates the thigh laterally. As the hip flexes past about 60 to 90 degrees, its line of pull moves to the other side of the axis, so it abducts the flexed thigh and may rotate it medially. Sources differ on the exact angle.
answer.zh: 伸髋时，梨状肌在股骨长轴后方走行，使大腿外旋。屈髋超过约 60°–90° 后，它的拉力线移到长轴另一侧，于是使屈曲的大腿外展，并可能内旋。具体角度各资料说法不一。

question.en: Which three muscles form the pes anserinus, and which nerve supplies each?
question.zh: 哪三块肌肉组成鹅足？各由什么神经支配？

answer.en: Sartorius, gracilis and semitendinosus insert together on the upper medial surface of the tibia as the pes anserinus. Sartorius is supplied by the femoral nerve, gracilis by the obturator nerve and semitendinosus by the tibial division of the sciatic nerve, so the three come from three different nerves and three different compartments.
answer.zh: 缝匠肌、股薄肌和半腱肌共同止于胫骨上端内侧面，组成鹅足。缝匠肌由股神经支配，股薄肌由闭孔神经支配，半腱肌由坐骨神经胫神经部分支配，三块肌肉分别来自三条神经、三个肌间隔。

question.en: Why is the hip most stable in extension?
question.zh: 为什么髋关节在伸展位最稳定？

answer.en: The iliofemoral, pubofemoral and ischiofemoral ligaments wind spirally around the femoral neck. Extension twists them tighter and presses the femoral head into the acetabulum, so extension with slight medial rotation and abduction is the close-packed position. In flexion the ligaments slacken.
answer.zh: 髂股韧带、耻股韧带和坐股韧带绕股骨颈呈螺旋走行。伸髋时它们被拧紧，把股骨头压进髋臼，所以伸展加轻度内旋、外展是闭合位。屈髋时这些韧带松弛。

spinalNerveVsVertebra.en: A spinal nerve level identifies a nerve, whereas a vertebral level identifies a bone. Specify which is being described.
spinalNerveVsVertebra.zh: 脊神经节段表示神经，椎骨节段表示骨骼；描述时应明确区分。

location.en: Gallbladder Meridian of Foot-Shaoyang. In the buttock region, at the junction of the lateral one third and the medial two thirds of the line connecting the most prominent point of the greater trochanter of the femur with the sacral hiatus. WHO 2008: In the buttock region, at the junction of the lateral one third and medial two thirds of the line connecting the prominence of the greater trochanter with the sacral hiatus.
location.zh: 足少阳胆经。在臀部，股骨大转子最凸点与骶管裂孔连线的外1/3与内2/3交点处。

layers.en: Skin, then the subcutaneous tissue and the thick gluteus maximus; deep to it lie the piriformis and the short external rotators (gemelli, obturator internus, quadratus femoris), and the sciatic nerve with the inferior gluteal nerve and vessels emerges below the piriformis in this region.
layers.zh: 皮肤、皮下组织，然后是很厚的臀大肌；其深面是梨状肌和短外旋肌群（上、下孖肌，闭孔内肌，股方肌），坐骨神经及臀下神经、血管在此区域从梨状肌下缘穿出。

target.en: Gluteus maximus and piriformis trigger points; it is a common dry-needling region for deep gluteal (piriformis) pain.
target.zh: 臀大肌和梨状肌触发点；此处是深臀部（梨状肌）疼痛常用的干针区域。

howToFind.en: Have the person lie on the side with the upper hip and knee flexed; find the most prominent point of the greater trochanter and the sacral hiatus, draw the line between them, and take the point one third of the way from the trochanter.
howToFind.zh: 侧卧，上侧髋、膝屈曲；找到股骨大转子最凸点和骶管裂孔，两点连线，从大转子一侧量取全长 1/3 处即是。

safety.en: The sciatic nerve passes deep to this point after emerging below the piriformis, so deep pressure or needling here can irritate the nerve; this is a learning reference only and does not indicate needling depth or direction.
safety.zh: 坐骨神经从梨状肌下缘穿出后经过此穴深面，深压或针刺可能刺激神经；此处仅作学习参照，不表示进针深度或方向。

location.en: Gallbladder Meridian of Foot-Shaoyang. In the buttock region, at the midpoint of the line connecting the anterior superior iliac spine with the most prominent point of the greater trochanter.
location.zh: 足少阳胆经。在臀部，髂前上棘与股骨大转子最凸点连线的中点处。

layers.en: Skin and subcutaneous tissue, then the tensor fasciae latae and the anterior fibres of the gluteus medius, with the gluteus minimus deepest over the ilium; the superior gluteal nerve runs between the gluteus medius and minimus, and the lateral femoral cutaneous nerve enters the thigh just medial to the anterior superior iliac spine.
layers.zh: 皮肤、皮下组织，然后是阔筋膜张肌和臀中肌前部纤维，最深层是贴近髂骨的臀小肌；臀上神经走行于臀中肌与臀小肌之间，股外侧皮神经在髂前上棘内侧进入大腿。

target.en: Tensor fasciae latae and anterior gluteus medius/minimus trigger points, which refer pain to the lateral hip and thigh.
target.zh: 阔筋膜张肌及臀中肌、臀小肌前部触发点，牵涉痛到髋外侧和大腿外侧。

howToFind.en: With the person supine or side-lying, palpate the anterior superior iliac spine and the most prominent point of the greater trochanter, and take the midpoint of the line between them; resisted hip abduction and internal rotation make the tensor fasciae latae bulge here.
howToFind.zh: 仰卧或侧卧，摸到髂前上棘和股骨大转子最凸点，取两点连线中点；做抗阻髋外展、内旋时阔筋膜张肌在此鼓起。

safety.en: The superior gluteal nerve and vessels lie deep between the gluteus medius and minimus, and the lateral femoral cutaneous nerve lies near the anterior superior iliac spine; this is a learning reference only and does not indicate needling depth or direction.
safety.zh: 深面臀中肌与臀小肌之间有臀上神经、血管，髂前上棘附近有股外侧皮神经；此处仅作学习参照，不表示进针深度或方向。

location.en: Bladder Meridian of Foot-Taiyang. In the buttock region, level with the fourth posterior sacral foramen, 3 cun lateral to the median sacral crest.
location.zh: 足太阳膀胱经。在臀部，横平第4骶后孔，骶正中嵴旁开3寸。

layers.en: Skin and subcutaneous tissue, then the gluteus maximus; deep to it lies the region of the lower border of the piriformis, where the inferior gluteal nerve and vessels and the sciatic nerve leave the pelvis through the greater sciatic foramen.
layers.zh: 皮肤、皮下组织，然后是臀大肌；其深面是梨状肌下缘区域，臀下神经、血管和坐骨神经在此经坐骨大孔出盆。

target.en: Gluteus maximus and medial piriformis trigger points; it is used as a dry-needling region for buttock pain.
target.zh: 臀大肌和梨状肌内侧部触发点；是臀部疼痛的干针区域。

howToFind.en: With the person prone, find the fourth posterior sacral foramen (about level with the sacral hiatus region) and measure 3 cun lateral to the median sacral crest.
howToFind.zh: 俯卧，找到第 4 骶后孔水平（接近骶管裂孔水平），从骶正中嵴向外量 3 寸。

safety.en: The sciatic nerve and the inferior gluteal neurovascular bundle lie deep to this point at the lower border of the piriformis; this is a learning reference only and does not indicate needling depth or direction.
safety.zh: 此穴深面、梨状肌下缘有坐骨神经和臀下神经血管束；此处仅作学习参照，不表示进针深度或方向。

location.en: Bladder Meridian of Foot-Taiyang. In the buttock region, at the midpoint of the gluteal fold. WHO 2008: In the buttock region, at the midpoint of the gluteal fold.
location.zh: 足太阳膀胱经。在臀部，臀沟的中点。

layers.en: Skin and subcutaneous tissue with the posterior femoral cutaneous nerve, then the lower border of the gluteus maximus; deeper lies the common origin of the long head of the biceps femoris and the semitendinosus from the ischial tuberosity, with the sciatic nerve lateral to the tuberosity.
layers.zh: 皮肤、皮下组织（有股后皮神经），然后是臀大肌下缘；更深是股二头肌长头和半腱肌在坐骨结节的共同起点，坐骨神经位于坐骨结节外侧。

target.en: Proximal hamstring origin and lower gluteus maximus; it relates to proximal hamstring trigger points and tendinopathy pain.
target.zh: 腘绳肌近端起点和臀大肌下部；与腘绳肌近端触发点和肌腱病疼痛有关。

howToFind.en: With the person prone, find the gluteal fold and take its midpoint; resisted knee flexion makes the hamstring origin tighten just below it.
howToFind.zh: 俯卧，找到臀沟取其中点；抗阻屈膝时，其下方的腘绳肌起点收紧。

safety.en: The sciatic nerve runs deep and slightly lateral to this point, so deep pressure can provoke nerve symptoms; this is a learning reference only and does not indicate needling depth or direction.
safety.zh: 坐骨神经在此穴深面稍外侧下行，深压可能诱发神经症状；此处仅作学习参照，不表示进针深度或方向。

location.en: Bladder Meridian of Foot-Taiyang. On the posterior aspect of the thigh, 6 cun below the gluteal fold, between the biceps femoris and the semitendinosus. WHO 2008: On the posterior aspect of the thigh, between the biceps femoris and the semitendinosus muscles, 6 B-cun inferior to the gluteal fold; note 2 places it 1 B-cun superior to the midpoint of the line connecting BL36 with BL40.
location.zh: 足太阳膀胱经。在股后侧，臀沟下6寸，股二头肌与半腱肌之间。

layers.en: Skin and subcutaneous tissue with branches of the posterior femoral cutaneous nerve, then the groove between the biceps femoris (laterally) and the semitendinosus (medially); the sciatic nerve lies deep in this groove on the adductor magnus.
layers.zh: 皮肤、皮下组织（有股后皮神经分支），然后是外侧股二头肌与内侧半腱肌之间的肌间沟；坐骨神经在此沟深面贴着大收肌下行。

target.en: Mid-belly hamstring trigger points (biceps femoris and semitendinosus).
target.zh: 腘绳肌肌腹中段触发点（股二头肌和半腱肌）。

howToFind.en: With the person prone and the knee flexed against resistance, the semitendinosus and biceps femoris stand out; take the groove between them 6 cun below the gluteal fold.
howToFind.zh: 俯卧抗阻屈膝时，半腱肌和股二头肌更明显；在两肌之间的沟里、臀沟下 6 寸取穴。

safety.en: The sciatic nerve lies directly deep to this intermuscular groove; this is a learning reference only and does not indicate needling depth or direction.
safety.zh: 坐骨神经正位于此肌间沟深面；此处仅作学习参照，不表示进针深度或方向。

location.en: Stomach Meridian of Foot-Yangming. On the anterior aspect of the thigh, in the depression among three muscles: the proximal rectus femoris, the sartorius and the tensor fasciae latae. WHO 2008: On the anterior aspect of the thigh, in the depression among three muscles: the proximal portion of the rectus femoris muscle, the sartorius muscle and the tensor fasciae latae muscle; note 2 places it where the line from the anterior superior iliac spine to the lateral end of the base of the patella crosses the horizontal line of the inferior border of the pubic symphysis.
location.zh: 足阳明胃经。在股前侧，股直肌近端、缝匠肌与阔筋膜张肌3条肌肉之间凹陷中。

layers.en: Skin and subcutaneous tissue with branches of the lateral femoral cutaneous nerve, then the gap between the sartorius (medially) and the tensor fasciae latae (laterally) over the proximal rectus femoris; branches of the lateral circumflex femoral vessels lie deep, and the femoral nerve, artery and vein lie further medially in the femoral triangle.
layers.zh: 皮肤、皮下组织（有股外侧皮神经分支），然后是内侧缝匠肌与外侧阔筋膜张肌之间、股直肌近端上方的间隙；深面有旋股外侧血管分支，股神经、股动脉和股静脉位于更内侧的股三角内。

target.en: Proximal rectus femoris and tensor fasciae latae trigger points.
target.zh: 股直肌近端和阔筋膜张肌触发点。

howToFind.en: With the hip and knee slightly flexed and the thigh slightly abducted against resistance, a triangular depression appears below the anterior superior iliac spine; take the deepest point just below its apex.
howToFind.zh: 髋、膝微屈，大腿抗阻轻度外展，髂前上棘下方出现一个三角形凹陷；在三角尖端下方最深处取穴。

safety.en: The femoral neurovascular bundle lies medial to this point in the femoral triangle and the lateral femoral cutaneous nerve is nearby, so do not drift medially; this is a learning reference only and does not indicate needling depth or direction.
safety.zh: 股神经血管束位于此穴内侧的股三角中，附近还有股外侧皮神经，定位不可偏向内侧；此处仅作学习参照，不表示进针深度或方向。

location.en: Stomach Meridian of Foot-Yangming. On the anterolateral aspect of the thigh, 6 cun above the base of the patella, on the line connecting the anterior superior iliac spine with the lateral end of the base of the patella. WHO 2008: On the anterolateral aspect of the thigh, on the line connecting the lateral end of the base of the patella with the anterior superior iliac spine, 6 B-cun superior to the base of the patella.
location.zh: 足阳明胃经。在股前外侧，髌底上6寸，髂前上棘与髌底外侧端的连线上。

layers.en: Skin and subcutaneous tissue with anterior and lateral cutaneous nerves of the thigh, then the rectus femoris and the vastus lateralis, with the vastus intermedius deepest on the femur; the descending branch of the lateral circumflex femoral artery runs nearby.
layers.zh: 皮肤、皮下组织（有股前皮神经和股外侧皮神经），然后是股直肌和股外侧肌，最深层是贴着股骨的股中间肌；旋股外侧动脉降支在附近走行。

target.en: Rectus femoris and vastus lateralis trigger points, which refer pain to the anterior thigh and knee.
target.zh: 股直肌和股外侧肌触发点，牵涉到大腿前方和膝部。

howToFind.en: With the person supine, draw the line from the anterior superior iliac spine to the lateral end of the base of the patella and take the point 6 cun above the patella; extending the knee against resistance makes the quadriceps belly bulge here.
howToFind.zh: 仰卧，连接髂前上棘与髌底外侧端，在髌底上 6 寸处取穴；抗阻伸膝时股四头肌肌腹在此鼓起。

safety.en: Thick muscle lies over the femur here and no major nerve trunk lies directly beneath, so it is relatively safe; this is a learning reference only and does not indicate needling depth or direction.
safety.zh: 此处股骨表面覆盖厚肌肉，正下方没有大的神经主干，相对安全；此处仅作学习参照，不表示进针深度或方向。

location.en: Gallbladder Meridian of Foot-Shaoyang. On the lateral aspect of the thigh, 9 cun above the popliteal crease, at the posterior border of the iliotibial band. WHO 2008: On the lateral aspect of the thigh, in the depression posterior to the iliotibial band where the tip of the middle finger rests when standing up with the arms hanging alongside the thigh.
location.zh: 足少阳胆经。在股外侧，腘横纹上9寸，髂胫束后缘。

layers.en: Skin and subcutaneous tissue with branches of the lateral femoral cutaneous nerve, then the posterior border of the iliotibial band, with the vastus lateralis in front and the short head of the biceps femoris behind and deep.
layers.zh: 皮肤、皮下组织（有股外侧皮神经分支），然后是髂胫束后缘，前方是股外侧肌，后深方是股二头肌短头。

target.en: Vastus lateralis and iliotibial band region trigger points, which relate to lateral thigh pain.
target.zh: 股外侧肌和髂胫束区触发点，与大腿外侧疼痛有关。

howToFind.en: Measure 9 cun above the popliteal crease on the lateral thigh and feel for the groove just behind the firm iliotibial band; in standing with the arms hanging, the middle fingertip usually lands nearby.
howToFind.zh: 在大腿外侧从腘横纹向上量 9 寸，在坚韧的髂胫束后方摸到凹沟；直立垂臂时中指尖通常落在附近。

safety.en: No major nerve trunk lies directly beneath, so it is relatively safe, but the sciatic nerve lies further posterior and medial; this is a learning reference only and does not indicate needling depth or direction.
safety.zh: 正下方没有大的神经主干，相对安全，但坐骨神经位于更后内侧；此处仅作学习参照，不表示进针深度或方向。

location.en: Liver Meridian of Foot-Jueyin. On the medial aspect of the thigh, 2 cun directly below Qichong (ST30).
location.zh: 足厥阴肝经。在股内侧，气冲（ST30）直下2寸。

layers.en: Skin and subcutaneous tissue, then the adductor longus and pectineus near their pubic origins, with the adductor brevis deeper; the anterior branch of the obturator nerve lies deep, and the femoral vein and great saphenous vein lie close laterally at the medial edge of the femoral triangle.
layers.zh: 皮肤、皮下组织，然后是靠近耻骨起点的长收肌和耻骨肌，更深是短收肌；深面有闭孔神经前支，外侧紧邻股三角内缘的股静脉和大隐静脉。

target.en: Proximal adductor longus and pectineus trigger points, which relate to groin pain.
target.zh: 长收肌近端和耻骨肌触发点，与腹股沟疼痛有关。

howToFind.en: Locate ST30 (level with the upper border of the pubic symphysis, 2 cun lateral to the midline, medial to the femoral artery pulse) and measure 2 cun straight down; resisted adduction makes the adductor longus tendon stand out here.
howToFind.zh: 先找 ST30（平耻骨联合上缘，前正中线旁开 2 寸，股动脉搏动内侧），再直下 2 寸；抗阻内收时长收肌腱在此明显。

safety.en: The femoral vein, femoral artery and great saphenous vein lie just lateral to this point, so feel for the femoral pulse and stay medial to it; this is a learning reference only and does not indicate needling depth or direction.
safety.zh: 股静脉、股动脉和大隐静脉就在此穴外侧，应先摸到股动脉搏动并保持在其内侧；此处仅作学习参照，不表示进针深度或方向。
